title: Forking-Sequences: Statistically and Computationally Efficient Multi-Horizon Forecasting with Reduced Volatility
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: While accuracy is a critical requirement for time series forecasting, an equally important desideratum is reasonable forecast volatility across forecast creation dates (FCDs). Even highly accurate models can produce erratic revisions between FCDs, undermining trust and disrupting downstream decision-making. To improve the volatility of forecast revisions, state-of-the-art models like MQCNN, MQT, and SPADE employ a powerful yet underexplored neural network architectural design: forking-sequences. This architectural design jointly encodes and decodes the entire time series across all FCDs, producing an entire multi-horizon forecast grid in a single forward pass. This approach contrasts with conventional neural forecasting methods that process FCDs independently, generating only a single multi-horizon forecast per forward pass. In this work, we formalize the forking-sequences design and motivate its broader adoption by introducing a metric for quantifying excess volatility in forecast revisions and by providing theoretical and empirical analysis. We theoretically motivate three key benefits of forking-sequences: (i) reduced forecast volatility through ensembling; (ii) gradient variance reduction, improving the statistical efficiency of the training procedure; and (iii) improved inference computational efficiency. We validate the benefits of forking-sequences compared to baseline window-sampling on the M-series benchmark, using 16 datasets from the M1, M3, M4, and Tourism competitions. We observe median sCRPS improvements across datasets of 46.2%, 49.3%, 28.6%, 24.7%, and 6.4% for RNN, LSTM, CNN, Transformer, and State Space-based architectures, respectively. We then show that forecast ensembling during inference can reduce median forecast volatility by 13.2%, 13.0%, 10.9%, 10.2%, and 11.2% for these respective models trained with forking-sequences, while maintaining accuracy.
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research

title: Robust stability of event-triggered nonlinear moving horizon estimation
summary: In this work, we propose an event-triggered moving horizon estimation (ET-MHE) scheme for the remote state estimation of general nonlinear systems. In the presented method, whenever an event is triggered, a single measurement is transmitted and the nonlinear MHE optimization problem is subsequently solved. If no event is triggered, the current state estimate is updated using an open-loop prediction based on the system dynamics. Moreover, we introduce a novel event-triggering rule under which we demonstrate robust global exponential stability of the ET-MHE scheme, assuming a suitable detectability condition is met. In addition, we show that with the adoption of a varying horizon length, a tighter bound on the estimation error can be achieved. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed method through two illustrative examples.

title: Contrastive Weak-to-strong Generalization
summary: Weak-to-strong generalization provides a promising paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs) by training stronger models on samples from aligned weaker ones, without requiring human feedback or explicit reward modeling. However, its robustness and generalization are hindered by the noise and biases in weak-model outputs, which limit its applicability in practice. To address this challenge, we leverage implicit rewards, which approximate explicit rewards through log-likelihood ratios, and reveal their structural equivalence with Contrastive Decoding (CD), a decoding strategy shown to reduce noise in LLM generation. Building on this connection, we propose Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG), a framework that employs contrastive decoding between pre- and post-alignment weak models to generate higher-quality samples. This approach enables more reliable capability transfer, denoising, and improved robustness, substantially mitigating the limitations of traditional weak-to-strong methods. Empirical results across different model families confirm consistent improvements, demonstrating the generality and effectiveness of ConG. Taken together, our findings highlight the potential of ConG to advance weak-to-strong generalization and provide a promising pathway toward AGI.

title: From Adaptation to Intelligence: A Systematic Review of Data, Strategies, and Impact in Personalized VR
summary: As virtual reality (VR) systems advance, they are increasingly expected to adapt intelligently to individual users' states, abilities, and preferences. While prior research has examined user-state sensing and adaptive interaction design in VR, existing reviews typically address these aspects in isolation. In this paper, we examine the growing body of research on personalization in VR, with a particular focus on how user data collected during immersion is used to drive adaptive strategies that tailor the experience and enhance engagement, performance, or other specific goals. We synthesize findings from studies that employ adaptive techniques across diverse application domains and summarize a five-stage conceptual framework that unifies adaptive mechanisms across domains. Our analysis reveals emerging trends, including the integration of multimodal sensors, the transition from purely reactive to hybrid adaptation systems, and the adoption of artificial intelligence approaches. Finally, we identify key challenges related to data, modeling, and evaluation, and outline future research directions toward more effective and user-centered VR systems.

title: Memory-SAM: Human-Prompt-Free Tongue Segmentation via Retrieval-to-Prompt
summary: Accurate tongue segmentation is crucial for reliable TCM analysis. Supervised models require large annotated datasets, while SAM-family models remain prompt-driven. We present Memory-SAM, a training-free, human-prompt-free pipeline that automatically generates effective prompts from a small memory of prior cases via dense DINOv3 features and FAISS retrieval. Given a query image, mask-constrained correspondences to the retrieved exemplar are distilled into foreground/background point prompts that guide SAM2 without manual clicks or model fine-tuning. We evaluate on 600 expert-annotated images (300 controlled, 300 in-the-wild). On the mixed test split, Memory-SAM achieves mIoU 0.9863, surpassing FCN (0.8188) and a detector-to-box SAM baseline (0.1839). On controlled data, ceiling effects above 0.98 make small differences less meaningful given annotation variability, while our method shows clear gains under real-world conditions. Results indicate that retrieval-to-prompt enables data-efficient, robust segmentation of irregular boundaries in tongue imaging. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/memory-sam.

title: AV-Master: Dual-Path Comprehensive Perception Makes Better Audio-Visual Question Answering
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT'26)
summary: Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) requires models to effectively utilize both visual and auditory modalities to answer complex and diverse questions about audio-visual scenes. However, existing methods lack sufficient flexibility and dynamic adaptability in temporal sampling and modality preference awareness, making it difficult to focus on key information based on the question. This limits their reasoning capability in complex scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework named AV-Master. It enhances the model's ability to extract key information from complex audio-visual scenes with substantial redundant content by dynamically modeling both temporal and modality dimensions. In the temporal dimension, we introduce a dynamic adaptive focus sampling mechanism that progressively focuses on audio-visual segments most relevant to the question, effectively mitigating redundancy and segment fragmentation in traditional sampling methods. In the modality dimension, we propose a preference-aware strategy that models each modality's contribution independently, enabling selective activation of critical features. Furthermore, we introduce a dual-path contrastive loss to reinforce consistency and complementarity across temporal and modality dimensions, guiding the model to learn question-specific cross-modal collaborative representations. Experiments on four large-scale benchmarks show that AV-Master significantly outperforms existing methods, especially in complex reasoning tasks.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT'26)

title: SpikeATac: A Multimodal Tactile Finger with Taxelized Dynamic Sensing for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: In this work, we introduce SpikeATac, a multimodal tactile finger combining a taxelized and highly sensitive dynamic response (PVDF) with a static transduction method (capacitive) for multimodal touch sensing. Named for its `spiky' response, SpikeATac's 16-taxel PVDF film sampled at 4 kHz provides fast, sensitive dynamic signals to the very onset and breaking of contact. We characterize the sensitivity of the different modalities, and show that SpikeATac provides the ability to stop quickly and delicately when grasping fragile, deformable objects. Beyond parallel grasping, we show that SpikeATac can be used in a learning-based framework to achieve new capabilities on a dexterous multifingered robot hand. We use reinforcement learning from human feedback to fine-tune the behavior of a policy to modulate force. Our hardware platform and learning pipeline together enable a difficult dexterous and contact-rich task that has not previously been achieved: in-hand manipulation of fragile objects. Videos are available at https://roamlab.github.io/spikeatac/ .

title: Leveraging Multi-Agent System (MAS) and Fine-Tuned Small Language Models (SLMs) for Automated Telecom Network Troubleshooting
comments: 6 pages, 7 figures, 1 table, 2026 IEEE ICC Workshop on Wireless Foundation Models for AI-native 6G and Beyond
summary: Telecom networks are rapidly growing in scale and complexity, making effective management, operation, and optimization increasingly challenging. Although Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been applied to many telecom tasks, existing models are often narrow in scope, require large amounts of labeled data, and struggle to generalize across heterogeneous deployments. Consequently, network troubleshooting continues to rely heavily on Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to manually correlate various data sources to identify root causes and corrective actions. To address these limitations, we propose a Multi-Agent System (MAS) that employs an agentic workflow, with Large Language Models (LLMs) coordinating multiple specialized tools for fully automated network troubleshooting. Once faults are detected by AI/ML-based monitors, the framework dynamically activates agents such as an orchestrator, solution planner, executor, data retriever, and root-cause analyzer to diagnose issues and recommend remediation strategies within a short time frame. A key component of this system is the solution planner, which generates appropriate remediation plans based on internal documentation. To enable this, we fine-tuned a Small Language Model (SLM) on proprietary troubleshooting documents to produce domain-grounded solution plans. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly accelerates troubleshooting automation across both Radio Access Network (RAN) and Core network domains.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, 1 table, 2026 IEEE ICC Workshop on Wireless Foundation Models for AI-native 6G and Beyond

title: List Decoding of Reed-Solomon Codes and Folded Reed-Solomon Codes Over Galois Ring
summary: List decoding of codes can be seen as the generalization of unique decoding of codes while list decoding over finite fields has been extensively studied, extending these results to more general algebraic structures such as Galois rings remains an important challenge. Due to recent progress in zero knowledge systems, there is a growing demand to investigate the proximity gap of codes over Galois rings in Yizhou Yao(2025). The proximity gap is closely related to the decoding capability of codes. It was shown in Eli Ben-Sasson(2020) that the proximity gap for RS codes over finite field can be improved to $1-\sqrt{r}$ if one consider list decoding instead of unique decoding. However, we know very little about RS codes over Galois ring which might hinder the development of zero knowledge proof system for ring-based arithmetic circuit. In this work, we first extend the list decoding procedure of Guruswami and Sudan to Reed-Solomon codes over Galois rings, which shows that RS codes with rate $r$ can be list decoded up to radius $1-\sqrt{r}$. Then, we investigate the list decoding of folded Reed-Solomon codes over Galois rings. We show that the list decoding radius of folded Reed-Solomon codes can reach the Singlton bound as its counterpart over finite field. We also extend the deterministic pruning method of Vikrant Ashvinkumar(2026) to Galois rings, showing how to prune the affine free module obtained from the linear-algebraic decoder and recover the candidate codewords. Finally, we improve the list size of our folded Reed-Solomon code to $O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ by extending recent work in Shashank Srivastava(2025) to Galois Rings. By developing the recent work of Yeyuan Chen(2025), we show that folded Reed-Solomon codes over Galois rings satisfy the relaxed generalized Singleton bound in the average-radius sense with optimal list size $O(1/\varepsilon)$.

title: Probabilistic Textual Time Series Depression Detection
summary: Accurate and interpretable predictions of depression severity are essential for clinical decision support, yet existing models often lack uncertainty estimates and temporal interpretability. We propose PTTSD, a Probabilistic framework for Depression Detection from clinical interview utterance sequences that predicts PHQ-8 scores while modeling calibrated uncertainty. PTTSD includes sequence-to-sequence and sequence-to-one variants, both combining LSTMs, self-attention, and residual connections with Gaussian or Student's-t output heads trained via negative log-likelihood. The sequence-to-sequence variant enables temporal analysis of how predictive confidence evolves over an interview, despite the target being a single session-level score. Evaluated on E-DAIC and DAIC-WOZ, PTTSD achieves competitive performance among text-only systems (e.g., MAE = 3.85 on E-DAIC, 3.55 on DAIC) and produces well-calibrated prediction intervals. Ablations confirm the value of attention and probabilistic modeling, while a three-part calibration analysis and qualitative case studies highlight the clinical relevance of uncertainty-aware prediction.

title: Data Provenance as Automatic Differentiation
summary: Automatic differentiation (AD) computes the derivative of a program alongside the program itself, as a linear map between tangent spaces, propagated forwards or backwards along an execution. We present a semantic framework that models data provenance via the same construction: taking scalars from a commutative semiring of dependency information rather than the real numbers, the derivative of a program becomes a linear map between spaces of approximations of its input and output. The choice of semiring determines the notion of provenance. Over the two-element Boolean algebra, the Jacobian of a program records which input positions each output position may depend on, and composing Jacobians forwards or backwards is dependency analysis in the manner of forward- and reverse-mode AD. More generally, over distributive lattices the Jacobian and its transpose propagate dependency information forwards and backwards as a conjugate pair of maps; when the lattice is a Boolean algebra, the two directions are moreover related by adjunction, recovering an approach called Galois slicing. We interpret a higher-order total functional language in this framework, prove that every program of first-order type denotes such a Jacobian, and instantiate the semiring to obtain dependency tracking (Booleans), automatic differentiation (reals), and quantitative interval provenance (the tropical semiring) as examples. All results are formalised in Agda.

title: Security Index from Input/Output Data: Theory and Computation
summary: The concept of a security index quantifies the minimum number of components that must be compromised to carry out a stealth attack. This metric enables system operators to assess the security risk of each component and implement countermeasures accordingly. In this paper, we introduce a data-driven security index that can be computed solely from input/output data when the system model is unknown. We show a sufficient condition under which the data-driven security index coincides with the model-based security index, which implies that the exact risk level of each component can be identified solely from data. We also provide an algorithm for computing the data-driven security index.

title: H3Former: Hypergraph-based Semantic-Aware Aggregation via Hyperbolic Hierarchical Contrastive Loss for Fine-Grained Visual Classification
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Fine-Grained Visual Classification (FGVC) remains a challenging task due to subtle inter-class differences and large intra-class variations. Existing approaches typically rely on feature-selection mechanisms or region-proposal strategies to localize discriminative regions for semantic analysis. However, these methods often fail to capture discriminative cues comprehensively while introducing substantial category-agnostic redundancy. To address these limitations, we propose H3Former, a novel token-to-region framework that leverages high-order semantic relations to aggregate local fine-grained representations with structured region-level modeling. Specifically, we propose the Semantic-Aware Aggregation Module (SAAM), which exploits multi-scale contextual cues to dynamically construct a weighted hypergraph among tokens. By applying hypergraph convolution, SAAM captures high-order semantic dependencies and progressively aggregates token features into compact region-level representations. Furthermore, we introduce the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Contrastive Loss (HHCL), which enforces hierarchical semantic constraints in a non-Euclidean embedding space. The HHCL enhances inter-class separability and intra-class consistency while preserving the intrinsic hierarchical relationships among fine-grained categories. Comprehensive experiments conducted on four standard FGVC benchmarks validate the superiority of our H3Former framework.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing

title: Bifurcations in Interior Transmission Eigenvalues: Theory and Computation
summary: The interior transmission eigenvalue problem (ITP) plays a central role in inverse scattering theory and in the spectral analysis of inhomogeneous media. Despite its smooth dependence on the refractive index at the PDE level, the corresponding spectral map from material parameters to eigenpairs may exhibit non-smooth or bifurcating behavior. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework identifying sufficient conditions for such non-smooth spectral behavior in the ITP on general domains. We further specialize our analysis to some radially symmetric geometries, enabling a more precise characterization of bifurcations in the spectrum. Computationally, we formulate the ITP as a parametric, discrete, nonlinear eigenproblem and use a match-based adaptive contour eigensolver to accurately and efficiently track eigenvalue trajectories under parameter variation. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical predictions and reveal novel non-smooth spectral effects.

title: Compression with Privacy-Preserving Random Access
comments: The present version contains significant updates to the proofs and presentation
summary:
We show that an i.i.d.\ binary source sequence $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ can be losslessly compressed at any rate above entropy while ensuring that the decoding of any $X_i$ reveals no information about the remaining symbols $\{X_j : j \neq i\}$.
  This problem reduces to a marginal consistency problem induced by the simultaneous privacy and reliability constraints. To address it, we develop a technique based on a geometric representation of codeword distributions, which may be of independent interest.
comment: The present version contains significant updates to the proofs and presentation

title: AutoGraphAD: Unsupervised network anomaly detection using Variational Graph Autoencoders
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Network Softwarization (NetSoft)
summary: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are essential tools for detecting network attacks and intrusions. While extensive research has explored the use of supervised Machine Learning for attack detection and characterisation, these methods require accurately labelled datasets, which are very costly to obtain. Moreover, existing public datasets have limited and/or outdated attacks, and many of them suffer from mislabelled data. To reduce the reliance on labelled data, we propose AutoGraphAD, a novel unsupervised anomaly detection approach based on a Heterogeneous Variational Graph Autoencoder. AutoGraphAD operates on heterogeneous graphs, made from connection and IP nodes that represent network activity. The model is trained using unsupervised and contrastive learning, without relying on any labelled data. The model's losses are then weighted and combined in an anomaly score used for anomaly detection. Overall, AutoGraphAD yields the same, and in some cases better, results than Anomal-E, but without requiring costly downstream anomaly detectors. As a result, AutoGraphAD achieves around 1.18 orders of magnitude faster training and 1.03 orders of magnitude faster inference, which represents a significant advantage for operational deployment.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Network Softwarization (NetSoft)

title: Point of Order: Action-Aware LLM Persona Modeling for Data-Grounded Civic Deliberation
summary: LLM-based simulations can enable controlled studies of civic deliberation, but current systems lack speaker-attributed data and methods for evaluating long-form institutional behavior. ASR transcripts typically use anonymous labels such as $Speaker\_1$, preventing models from learning stable participant behavior across meetings. We present a reproducible pipeline that converts public Zoom recordings into speaker-attributed transcripts enriched with persona profiles, topics, and pragmatic "action tags" such as $[propose\_motion]$. Using this pipeline, we release three public datasets of government deliberation (Appellate Court hearings, School Board meetings, and Municipal Council sessions) and fine-tune LLM personas on this action-aware data. We evaluate simulations along four dimensions: persona fidelity, persona consistency, institutional fidelity, and behavioral coherence. Action-aware fine-tuning cuts perplexity by 67%, doubles classifier-based persona fidelity, increases vote attempts by up to $3.6\times$, and improves deliberative responsiveness by up to 70%. Human evaluations show that simulated excerpts are often hard to distinguish from real deliberations, indicating a practical foundation for data-grounded civic simulation studies.

title: Improving Language Agents through BREW: Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly capable of complex, multi-step tasks such as GUI automation, tool use, and data manipulation, yet they cannot learn from experience: each new session rediscovers solutions from scratch. We introduce BREW (Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge), a framework that distills an agent's past interaction trajectories into a structured, retrievable knowledge base (KB) of natural-language recipes, concept-level procedural documents that capture what to do, when it applies, and what to watch out for.
  Drawing on the principle of library learning from program synthesis, BREW decomposes agent memory into modular, concept-localized documents and formalizes KB construction as a state-space search problem. To navigate this space, we introduce Expand-and-Gather Monte Carlo Tree Search (EG-MCTS), a reward-guided algorithm that jointly optimizes recipe accuracy and retrievability across parallel, per-concept search trees. We further adapt hindsight relabeling to convert near-miss trajectories into positive demonstrations, surfacing latent agent competencies as reusable knowledge.
  On three domain-grounded benchmarks, OSWorld, tau^2-Bench, and SpreadSheetBench, BREW achieves 10-20% gains in task success and 10-15% fewer execution steps over base agents, while consistently outperforming existing memory-augmented baselines that can degrade below memoryless performance. The resulting KB is inspectable, modular, and extensible, providing a transparent and controllable substrate for agent optimization.

AI.title_translation: 通过 BREW 提升语言智能体：引导经验学习的环境知识
AI.tldr: 本文提出 BREW 框架，通过将大语言模型智能体过去的交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化、可检索的自然语言配方知识库，使其能够从经验中学习，并在多项基准上显著提升了任务成功率和执行效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在处理复杂的、多步骤任务上表现出越来越强的能力，但它们缺乏从经验中学习的能力，导致在每个新会话中都必须从头开始重新探索解决方案。现有的记忆增强基线方法甚至可能导致性能退化。
AI.method: 提出 BREW 框架。该框架借鉴程序合成中的库学习原理，将智能体的记忆分解为模块化的、针对特定概念的文档，并将知识库构建公式化为状态空间搜索问题。为了解决该搜索问题，提出了“扩展与收集蒙特卡洛树搜索”（EG-MCTS）算法，在并行的多树结构中联合优化配方的准确性与可检索性。此外，还采用后视重标记（hindsight relabeling）技术，将接近成功的失败轨迹转化为积极的示范，以提取潜在的复用知识。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld、tau^2-Bench 和 SpreadSheetBench 三个领域基准测试上，BREW 相比基础智能体实现了 10-20% 的任务成功率提升，同时减少了 10-15% 的执行步骤。此外，BREW 持续优于现有的记忆增强基线，且不会出现基线方法中低于无记忆性能的退化现象。
AI.conclusion: BREW 框架能够有效地将智能体的历史交互轨迹转化为结构化、可检索且可检查的自然语言知识库。这不仅显著提升了智能体在复杂任务中的成功率并降低了执行步骤，还为智能体优化提供了一个透明、模块化和可控的基础。
AI.translation:
基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在处理复杂的、多步骤任务（如 GUI 自动化、工具使用和数据操作）方面能力日益增强，然而它们却无法从经验中学习：每个新会话都需要重新从头开始寻找解决方案。我们引入了 BREW（通过引导经验学习的环境知识），这是一个将智能体过去的交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化、可检索的自然语言“配方”知识库（KB）的框架，这些配方是捕获了“做什么”、“何时适用”以及“需要注意什么”的概念级程序文档。
借鉴程序合成中库学习的原理，BREW 将智能体的记忆分解为模块化、概念本地化的文档，并将知识库构建公式化为一个状态空间搜索问题。为了在这个空间中进行导航，我们引入了“扩展与收集蒙特卡洛树搜索”（EG-MCTS），这是一种奖励引导的算法，可在并行的、针对每个概念的搜索树中联合优化配方的准确性和可检索性。我们进一步调整了后视重标记，将接近成功的轨迹转化为积极的示范，从而将智能体的潜在能力显现为可重用的知识。
在三个领域基准（OSWorld、tau^2-Bench 和 SpreadSheetBench）上，BREW 相比基础智能体实现了 10-20% 的任务成功率提升，且执行步骤减少了 10-15%，同时持续优于现有的记忆增强基线（这些基线有时甚至会退化到低于无记忆的性能）。由此产生的知识库是可检查的、模块化的和可扩展的，为智能体优化提供了一个透明且可控的基础。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 BREW 框架，旨在解决大语言模型智能体无法从经验中学习的问题。BREW 通过将智能体过去的交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化、可检索的概念级自然语言“配方”知识库，实现了经验的积累。该框架采用创新的 EG-MCTS 算法来优化知识库构建，并结合后视重标记技术将近似失败的尝试转化为可复用的知识。实验表明，BREW 在多个基准上显著提升了智能体的任务成功率和执行效率，同时提供了一个透明且可控的知识基底。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 经验学习, 知识库构建, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 记忆增强
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：将程序合成中的“库学习”（library learning）概念引入 LLM 智能体的记忆管理中，把经验提炼为结构化的“配方”知识库，设计非常精妙。同时，EG-MCTS 搜索算法和后视重标记（hindsight relabeling）的结合，为自动化知识库构建提供了系统性的解决方案。
2. **重要性**：解决了当前 LLM 智能体无法从过去经验中学习、每次任务都需要重新探索的痛点，且生成的知识库具有高可解释性、模块化和可控性，避免了传统记忆增强方法可能带来的性能退化。
3. **局限性**（基于摘要推测）：构建和搜索该知识库（特别是运行 EG-MCTS）可能会带来额外的计算开销和延迟；此外，对于极度多变或非结构化的任务环境，如何准确定义和提取“概念级配方”可能存在挑战。

title: RIS-Assisted Downlink Pinching-Antenna Systems: GNN-Enabled Optimization Approaches
summary: This paper investigates a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multi-waveguide pinching-antenna (PA) system (PASS) for multi-user downlink information transmission, motivated by the unknown impact of the integration of emerging PASS and RIS on wireless communications. First, we formulate sum rate (SR) and energy efficiency (EE) maximization problems in a unified framework, subject to constraints on the movable region of PAs, total power budget, and tunable phase of RIS elements. Then, by leveraging a graph-structured topology of the RIS-assisted PASS, a novel three-stage graph neural network (GNN) is proposed, which learns PA positions based on user locations, and RIS phase shifts according to composite channel conditions at the first two stages, respectively, and finally determines beamforming vectors. Specifically, the proposed GNN is achieved through unsupervised training, together with three implementation strategies for its integration with convex optimization, thus offering trade-offs between inference time and solution optimality. Extensive numerical results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed GNN, and to support its unique attributes of viable generalization capability, good performance reliability, and real-time applicability. Moreover, the impact of key parameters on RIS-assisted PASS is illustrated and analyzed.

AI.title_translation: RIS辅助的下行压合天线系统：基于GNN的优化方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无监督图神经网络（GNN）的三阶段优化框架，用于解决RIS辅助压合天线系统（PASS）中的天线位置、RIS相移和波束赋形联合优化问题。
AI.motivation: 探索新兴的压合天线系统（PASS）与可重构智能表面（RIS）集成对无线通信的影响，并解决其带来的和速率与能量效率最大化联合优化难题。
AI.method: 提出一种基于图结构拓扑的新型三阶段图神经网络（GNN）框架。第一阶段根据用户位置学习PA位置，第二阶段根据复合信道条件学习RIS相移，第三阶段确定波束赋形向量。该GNN采用无监督训练，并结合了三种与凸优化集成的实施策略。
AI.result: 数值结果验证了所提GNN的有效性，证明了其具有良好的泛化能力、性能可靠性和实时适用性，并阐明了关键参数对系统的影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于GNN的优化方法能有效解决RIS辅助PASS中的联合优化问题，在保证良好性能和泛化能力的同时，实现了实时适用性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一种用于多用户下行信息传输的可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助多波导压合天线（PA）系统（PASS），其出发点是新兴的PASS与RIS的结合对无线通信的影响尚不明确。首先，我们在一个统一的框架下构建了和速率（SR）和能量效率（EE）最大化问题，该问题受限于PA的可移动区域、总功率预算以及RIS元件的可调相位。然后，利用RIS辅助PASS的图结构拓扑，提出了一种新型的三阶段图神经网络（GNN），它在第一阶段和第二阶段分别根据用户位置学习PA位置，并根据复合信道条件学习RIS相移，最后确定波束赋形向量。具体而言，所提出的GNN是通过无监督训练实现的，并结合了三种将其与凸优化集成的实施策略，从而在推理时间和解的优异性之间提供了折中。提供了广泛的数值结果来验证所提GNN的有效性，并支持其可行的泛化能力、良好的性能可靠性和实时适用性等独特属性。此外，阐述并分析了关键参数对RIS辅助PASS的影响。
AI.summary: 本文研究了RIS辅助的多波导压合天线系统（PASS）在多用户下行传输中的应用。为了最大化系统和速率与能量效率，本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的三阶段无监督学习优化框架，协同优化PA位置、RIS相移和波束赋形向量，并在推理时间和解的质量之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.keywords: 可重构智能表面 (RIS), 压合天线系统 (PASS), 图神经网络 (GNN), 联合优化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将压合天线系统（PASS）与RIS结合，并利用图神经网络（GNN）处理联合优化问题。其提出的三阶段无监督GNN结合凸优化的方案，为实际应用中推理时间与性能的权衡提供了很好的思路。局限在于摘要中未给出具体的复杂度对比和天线移动带来的硬件开销分析。

title: How to DP-fy Your Data: A Practical Guide to Generating Synthetic Data With Differential Privacy
summary:
High quality data is needed to unlock the full potential of AI for end users. However finding new sources of such data is getting harder: most publicly-available human generated data will soon have been used. Additionally, publicly available data often is not representative of users of a particular system -- for example, a research speech dataset of contractors interacting with an AI assistant will likely be more homogeneous, well articulated and self-censored than real world commands that end users will issue. Therefore unlocking high-quality data grounded in real user interactions is of vital interest. However, the direct use of user data comes with significant privacy risks. Differential Privacy (DP) is a well established framework for reasoning about and limiting information leakage, and is a gold standard for protecting user privacy. The focus of this work, \emph{Differentially Private Synthetic data}, refers to synthetic data that preserves the overall trends of source data,, while providing strong privacy guarantees to individuals that contributed to the source dataset. DP synthetic data can unlock the value of datasets that have previously been inaccessible due to privacy concerns and can replace the use of sensitive datasets that previously have only had rudimentary protections like ad-hoc rule-based anonymization.
  In this paper we explore the full suite of techniques surrounding DP synthetic data, the types of privacy protections they offer and the state-of-the-art for various modalities (image, tabular, text and decentralized). We outline all the components needed in a system that generates DP synthetic data, from sensitive data handling and preparation, to tracking the use and empirical privacy testing. We hope that work will result in increased adoption of DP synthetic data, spur additional research and increase trust in DP synthetic data approaches.

AI.title_translation: 如何实现数据差分隐私化：使用差分隐私生成合成数据的实用指南
AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于如何使用差分隐私（DP）生成合成数据的实用指南，系统梳理了适用于多模态数据的最新DP技术及构建安全合成数据系统所需的完整组件。
AI.motivation: AI的发展高度依赖高质量数据，但公开数据即将耗尽且缺乏真实用户的代表性。直接使用包含真实用户交互的高质量数据面临严重的隐私泄露风险，而传统的脱敏方法（如基于规则的临时匿名化）保护力度不足。因此，需要一种既能保留数据特征又能提供强隐私保证的解决方案。
AI.method: 本文系统地探讨了围绕DP合成数据的全套技术及其隐私保护类型，梳理了针对图像、表格、文本和去中心化等不同模态的最新技术（SOTA）。同时，详细规划了构建DP合成数据系统所需的所有关键组件，包括敏感数据处理与准备、使用情况追踪以及经验性隐私测试。
AI.result: 本文提供了一套完整的、面向多模态（图像、表格、文本、去中心化）的差分隐私合成数据生成指南，明确了从数据准备到隐私测试的系统级构建方案，为解决隐私合规下的数据孤岛问题提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私（DP）合成数据能够有效解决隐私保护与高质量数据利用之间的矛盾，替代传统的弱匿名化方法。本指南有望促进DP合成数据在实际业务中的广泛采用，激发相关领域的进一步研究，并增强业界对该技术的信任。
AI.translation:
释放人工智能（AI）的全部潜力需要高质量的数据。然而，寻找此类数据的新来源正变得越来越困难：大多数公开可用的人类生成数据很快都将被消耗殆尽。此外，公开数据往往无法代表特定系统的真实用户——例如，外包人员与AI助手交互的研究语音数据集，相比于终端用户在现实世界中发出的真实命令，可能会更加单一、清晰且带有自我审查。因此，释放基于真实用户交互的高质量数据具有至关重要的利益。然而，直接使用用户数据伴随着显著的隐私风险。差分隐私（DP）是一个用于推理和限制信息泄露的成熟框架，也是保护用户隐私的金标准。本工作的重点是“差分隐私合成数据”，它指的是既保留源数据总体趋势，又对为源数据集做出贡献的个人提供强大隐私保证的合成数据。DP合成数据可以释放以前因隐私问题而无法访问的数据集的价值，并取代以往仅具有粗糙保护（如基于规则的临时脱敏）的敏感数据集。
在本文中，我们探讨了围绕DP合成数据的全套技术、它们提供的隐私保护类型以及各种模态（图像、表格、文本和去中心化）的最新技术。我们概述了生成DP合成数据系统所需的所有组件，从敏感数据处理和准备，到跟踪使用和经验性隐私测试。我们希望这项工作能够促进DP合成数据的采用，激发更多研究，并提高对DP合成数据方法的信任。
AI.summary: 本文是一篇关于利用差分隐私（DP）生成合成数据的实用指南。针对AI发展中面临的高质量数据短缺与用户隐私保护之间的冲突，文章系统性地阐述了DP合成数据的概念及其在保护个人隐私的同时保留数据总体特征的优势。文章探讨了适用于图像、表格、文本和去中心化等多种模态的最新DP技术，并详细梳理了从敏感数据处理、准备到使用追踪和经验隐私测试的完整系统组件，旨在推动DP合成数据技术的落地应用和研究。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 合成数据, 隐私保护, 实用指南, 多模态数据
AI.comments:
1. 实用性极高：本文不仅讨论了理论，还从工程角度梳理了构建DP合成数据生成系统所需的完整组件，对工业界落地具有极高的参考价值。
2. 覆盖面广：涵盖了图像、表格、文本以及去中心化等多种主流数据模态，提供了全面的技术版图。
3. 局限性：作为一篇实用指南和综述性工作，其主要贡献在于系统性的框架梳理和方法总结，而非提出全新的单一突破性算法。

title: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving
summary:
As augmented large language models (LLMs) with external tools become increasingly popular in web applications, improving augmented LLM inference serving efficiency and optimizing service-level objectives (SLOs) are critical for enhancing user experience. To achieve this, inference systems must maximize request handling within latency constraints, referred to as increasing effective throughput. However, existing systems face two major challenges: (i) reliance on first-come-first-served (FCFS) scheduling causes severe head-of-line blocking, leading to queuing delays exceeding the SLOs for many requests; and (ii) static batch token limit, which fails to adapt to fluctuating loads and hardware conditions. Both of these factors degrade effective throughput and service quality.
  This paper presents AugServe, an efficient inference framework designed to reduce queueing latency and enhance effective throughput for augmented LLM inference services. The core idea of AugServe is a two-stage adaptive request scheduling strategy. Specifically, AugServe combines the inference features of augmented LLM requests to optimize the order of scheduling decisions (stage I). These decisions are continuously refined with runtime information (stage II), adapting to both request characteristics and system capabilities. In addition, AugServe dynamically adjusts the token batching mechanism based on hardware status and real-time load, further enhancing throughput performance. Experimental results show that AugServe achieves 4.7x and 3.3x higher effective throughput than vLLM and InferCept, while reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 96.3% and 95.0%, respectively.

AI.title_translation: AugServe：面向增强大语言模型推理服务的自适应请求调度
AI.tldr: 提出了 AugServe 框架，通过两阶段自适应请求调度和动态 Token 批处理机制，显著提高了增强大语言模型推理服务的有效吞吐量并降低了首字延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的增强大语言模型推理系统面临两个主要挑战：一是依赖先来先服务（FCFS）调度导致严重的队头阻塞和排队延迟超标；二是静态批处理 Token 限制无法适应波动的负载和硬件条件，从而降低了有效吞吐量和系统服务质量。
AI.method: 提出了 AugServe 推理框架，其核心是两阶段自适应请求调度策略：第一阶段结合增强 LLM 请求的推理特征优化调度顺序决策；第二阶段利用运行时信息持续细化这些决策。此外，AugServe 还根据硬件状态和实时负载动态调整 Token 批处理机制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与 vLLM 和 InferCept 相比，AugServe 的有效吞吐量分别提高了 4.7 倍和 3.3 倍，同时首字延迟（TTFT）分别降低了高达 96.3% 和 95.0%。
AI.conclusion: AugServe 通过结合两阶段自适应调度与动态批处理，能够有效减少排队延迟、优化服务水平目标（SLOs）并显著提升增强 LLM 推理服务的有效吞吐量。
AI.translation:
随着结合外部工具的增强大语言模型（LLM）在 Web 应用中日益普及，提高增强 LLM 推理服务效率并优化服务水平目标（SLO）对于提升用户体验至关重要。为此，推理系统必须在延迟约束内最大化请求处理能力，即提高“有效吞吐量”。然而，现有系统面临两大挑战：（i）依赖先来先服务（FCFS）调度会导致严重的队头阻塞，导致许多请求的排队延迟超过 SLO；以及（ii）静态批处理 Token 限制无法适应波动的负载和硬件条件。这两个因素都会降低有效吞吐量和服务质量。
本文提出了 AugServe，这是一个高效的推理框架，旨在减少排队延迟并提高增强 LLM 推理服务的有效吞吐量。AugServe 的核心思想是两阶段自适应请求调度策略。具体而言，AugServe 结合增强 LLM 请求的推理特征来优化调度决策顺序（第一阶段），并利用运行时信息持续细化这些决策（第二阶段），以适应请求特征和系统能力。此外，AugServe 还根据硬件状态和实时负载动态调整 Token 批处理机制，从而进一步提升吞吐量性能。实验结果表明，AugServe 的有效吞吐量比 vLLM 和 InferCept 分别高出 4.7 倍和 3.3 倍，同时首字延迟（TTFT）分别降低了高达 96.3% 和 95.0%。
AI.summary: 本文针对增强大语言模型（LLM）推理服务中因 FCFS 调度导致的队头阻塞以及静态批处理无法自适应负载的问题，提出了 AugServe 框架。该框架采用两阶段自适应请求调度策略，在第一阶段利用请求的推理特征优化调度顺序，在第二阶段结合运行时信息动态调整决策；同时，它还能根据硬件状态和实时负载动态调整 Token 批处理。实验表明，AugServe 在有效吞吐量和 TTFT 降低上均显著优于 vLLM 和 InferCept。
AI.keywords: 增强大语言模型, 推理服务, 自适应请求调度, 动态批处理, 有效吞吐量
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型（特别是结合外部工具的增强 LLM）推理服务中的调度痛点，创新性地提出了两阶段自适应调度和动态批处理机制。其显著的实验结果（吞吐量提升数倍，TTFT 降低超 95%）证明了该方法的实用价值和高效性，对于优化云端 LLM 推理服务的服务水平目标（SLO）具有重要参考意义。

title: ReinforceGen: Hybrid Skill Policies with Automated Data Generation and Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon manipulation has been a long-standing challenge in the robotics community. We propose ReinforceGen, a system that combines task decomposition, data generation, imitation learning, and motion planning to form an initial solution, and improves each component through reinforcement-learning-based fine-tuning. ReinforceGen first segments the task into multiple localized skills, which are connected through motion planning. The skills and motion planning targets are trained with imitation learning on a dataset generated from 10 human demonstrations, and then fine-tuned through online adaptation and reinforcement learning. When benchmarked on the Robosuite dataset, ReinforceGen reaches 80% success rate on all tasks with visuomotor controls in the highest reset range setting. Additional ablation studies show that our fine-tuning approaches contribute to an 89% average performance increase. Finally, ReinforceGen demonstrates significant improvement through fine-tuning in our real-world evaluations. More results and videos are available at https://reinforcegen.github.io.

AI.title_translation: ReinforceGen：结合自动数据生成与强化学习的混合技能策略
AI.tldr: ReinforceGen通过将任务分解、模仿学习与强化学习微调相结合，仅需10个真人演示即可在长程机器人操纵任务中实现显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 解决机器人领域中长期存在的长程操纵（Long-horizon manipulation）挑战。
AI.method: 提出ReinforceGen系统。该系统首先将任务分解为多个局部技能，并通过运动规划将它们连接起来；接着，利用从10个真人演示中生成的数据集，通过模仿学习对这些技能和运动规划目标进行初始训练；最后，通过在线自适应和强化学习对各个组件进行微调。
AI.result: 在Robosuite基准测试中，在最高重置范围设置下，ReinforceGen在所有视觉运动控制任务上达到了80%的成功率。消融实验表明，微调方法带来了89%的平均性能提升。此外，在真实世界评估中也展示了显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: ReinforceGen通过结合任务分解、自动化数据生成以及强化学习微调，能够有效解决长程机器人操纵任务，并在仿真和真实世界中均表现出显著的性能改进。
AI.translation: 长程操纵一直是机器人领域面临的长期挑战。我们提出了ReinforceGen，这是一个将任务分解、数据生成、模仿学习和运动规划相结合以形成初始解决方案，并通过基于强化学习的微调来改进每个组件的系统。ReinforceGen首先将任务分割为多个局部技能，并通过运动规划将它们连接起来。这些技能和运动规划目标在由10个真人演示生成的数据集上通过模仿学习进行训练，然后通过在线自适应和强化学习进行微调。在Robosuite数据集上进行基准测试时，ReinforceGen在最高重置范围设置下的所有视觉运动控制任务中达到了80%的成功率。额外的消融研究表明，我们的微调方法带来了89%的平均性能提升。最后，ReinforceGen在我们的真实世界评估中通过微调展示了显著的改进。更多结果和视频可在 https://reinforcegen.github.io 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为ReinforceGen的系统，旨在解决长程机器人操纵难题。该系统将任务分解为通过运动规划连接的局部技能，利用仅10个真人演示生成的数据进行模仿学习以构建初始方案，并通过在线自适应和强化学习进行微调。实验表明，该方法在仿真和真实世界中均取得了极高的成功率和性能提升。
AI.keywords: 长程操纵, 强化学习, 模仿学习, 任务分解, 机器人学
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将经典的运动规划、模仿学习与现代的强化学习微调相结合，仅需10个真人演示样本即可启动，具有极高的样本效率。其在仿真和真实世界中的双重验证进一步证明了该方法的实用价值。然而，在面对极度复杂的非结构化环境时，任务自动分解的鲁棒性和泛化能力可能仍需要更深入的探讨。

title: Self-transcendence: Is External Feature Guidance Indispensable for Accelerating Diffusion Transformer Training?
summary: Recent works such as REPA have shown that guiding diffusion models with external semantic features (e.g., DINO) can significantly accelerate the training of diffusion transformers (DiTs). However, the use of pretrained external features as guidance signals introduces additional dependencies. We argue that DiTs actually have the power to guide the training of themselves, and propose SelfTranscendence, an effective method that achieves fast convergence using internal feature supervision only. The desired internal guidance features should meet two requirements: structurally clean to help shallow blocks separate noise from signal, and semantically discriminative to help shallow layers learn effective representations. With this consideration, we first align the DiT features with the clean VAE latent features, a native component of latent diffusion, for a short training phase (e.g., 40 epochs) to improve their structural representations, then apply the classifier-free guidance to the intermediate features, enhancing their discriminative capability and semantic expressiveness. These enriched internal features, learned entirely within the model, are used as supervision signals to guide a new DiT training from scratch. Compared to existing self-contained methods, our approach achieves a significant performance boost. It can even surpass REPA, which uses the external DINO features as guidance, in both generation quality and convergence speed for both class-to-image and text-to-image generation tasks. The source code of our method can be found at https://github.com/csslc/Self-Transcendence.

AI.title_translation: 自我超越：外部特征引导对加速扩散Transformer训练是必不可少的吗？
AI.tldr: 提出SelfTranscendence方法，通过将DiT内部特征与原生VAE特征对齐并结合无分类器引导，实现仅靠内部特征进行自我监督训练，在无需外部特征（如DINO）的情况下实现了更快的收敛速度和更好的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 最近的研究（如REPA）通过引入外部语义特征（如DINO）来引导扩散模型，从而显著加速了DiT的训练，但这引入了额外的外部依赖。作者认为DiT自身就具备引导自我训练的能力，因此希望探索一种无需外部特征、仅依赖内部特征监督的快速收敛训练方法。
AI.method: 提出SelfTranscendence方法，分为以下步骤：1) 在一个简短的训练阶段（如40个epoch）中，将DiT特征与潜在扩散模型原生的干净VAE潜在特征进行对齐，以提升其结构表征能力；2) 对中间特征应用无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance），增强其判别能力和语义表达能力；3) 将这些完全在模型内部学习并富集后的内部特征作为监督信号，引导一个新的DiT从头开始训练。
AI.result: 与现有的自包含（self-contained）方法相比，SelfTranscendence实现了显著的性能提升。在类别到图像和文本到图像的生成任务中，它在生成质量和收敛速度上甚至超越了使用外部DINO特征进行引导的REPA方法。
AI.conclusion: 外部特征引导对于加速DiT训练并非必不可少。通过合理设计，利用DiT自身的内部特征（与VAE潜在特征对齐并应用无分类器引导）进行自我监督，可以实现比外部特征引导更高效、质量更好的DiT训练。
AI.translation: 最近的研究（如REPA）表明，使用外部语义特征（例如DINO）引导扩散模型可以显著加速扩散Transformer（DiT）的训练。然而，使用预训练的外部特征作为引导信号会引入额外的依赖。我们认为，DiT实际上有能力引导自身的训练，并提出了SelfTranscendence，这是一种仅使用内部特征监督就能实现快速收敛的高效方法。所期望的内部引导特征应满足两个要求：结构上足够干净以帮助浅层模块区分噪声与信号，以及在语义上具有判别性以帮助浅层学习有效的表征。基于这种考量，我们首先在一个简短的训练阶段（例如40个epoch）将DiT特征与干净的VAE潜在特征（潜在扩散的固有组件）进行对齐，以改善它们的结构表征，然后对中间特征应用无分类器引导，从而增强它们的判别能力和语义表达能力。这些完全在模型内部学习到的丰富内部特征被用作监督信号，来引导一个新的DiT从头开始训练。与现有的自包含方法相比，我们的方法实现了显著的性能提升。在类别到图像和文本到图像的生成任务中，它在生成质量和收敛速度上甚至可以超越使用外部DINO特征作为引导的REPA。我们方法的源代码可以在以下网址找到：https://github.com/csslc/Self-Transcendence。
AI.summary: 本文针对扩散Transformer（DiT）训练加速问题，提出了一种名为SelfTranscendence的自引导训练方法。该方法无需依赖DINO等外部预训练特征，而是通过将DiT内部特征与原生的干净VAE潜在特征对齐，并结合无分类器引导，从而在模型内部构建出兼具结构清晰度与语义判别性的引导信号。实验表明，该方法在类别/文本到图像生成任务上的收敛速度和生成质量均优于现有的自包含方法及外部特征引导方法。
AI.keywords: 扩散Transformer (Diffusion Transformer), 自我超越 (Self-Transcendence), 内部特征引导 (Internal Feature Guidance), 训练加速 (Training Acceleration)
AI.comments: 该论文的核心创新点在于挑战了“加速DiT训练必须依赖外部预训练特征”的既有假设。通过巧妙地利用DiT原生的VAE潜在特征进行对齐，并结合无分类器引导，生成了兼具结构清洁度和语义判别性的内部特征，实现了“自我引导”。这种设计消除了对DINO等外部大模型的依赖，降低了训练管线的复杂度，且实验结果表明其在收敛速度和生成质量上均超越了外部引导方法，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于该方法需要先进行一个简短的对齐训练阶段（如40 epochs）来获取引导特征，再重新从头训练DiT，这使得整体训练流程分为两阶段，稍显繁琐。

title: EZInput: A Cross-Environment Python Library for Easy UI Generation in Scientific Computing
summary: Researchers face a persistent barrier when applying computational algorithms with parameter configuration typically demanding programming skills, interfaces differing across environments, and settings rarely persisting between sessions. This fragmentation forces repetitive input, slows iterative exploration, and undermines reproducibility because parameter choices are difficult to record, share, and reuse. We present EZInput, a cross-runtime environment Python library enabling algorithm developers to automatically generate graphical user interfaces that make their computational tools accessible to end-users without programming expertise. EZInput employs a declarative specification system where developers define input requirements and validation constraints once; the library then handles environment detection, interface rendering, parameter validation, and session persistence across Jupyter notebooks, Google Colab, and terminal environments. This "write once, run anywhere" architecture enables researchers to prototype in notebooks and deploy identical parameter configurations for batch execution on remote systems without code changes or manual transcription. Parameter persistence, inspired by ImageJ/FIJI and adapted to Python workflows, saves and restores user configurations via lightweight YAML files, eliminating redundant input and producing shareable records that enhance reproducibility. EZInput supports diverse input types essential for scientific computing and it also includes built-in validation that ensures data integrity and clear feedback that reduces user friction.

AI.title_translation: EZInput：一个用于科学计算中轻松生成用户界面的跨环境Python库
AI.tldr: EZInput是一个跨环境的Python库，允许研究人员通过声明式规范自动生成GUI，并在Jupyter、Colab和终端之间实现参数持久化，从而简化科学计算中的参数配置并提高可重复性。
AI.motivation: 研究人员在应用计算算法时面临障碍：参数配置通常需要编程技能，不同运行环境之间的界面存在差异，且参数设置在会话之间难以持久保存。这种碎片化迫使研究人员进行重复输入，减缓了迭代探索，并因参数选择难以记录、共享和重用而损害了科学研究的可重复性。
AI.method: 提出EZInput，一个采用声明式规范系统的跨运行环境Python库。开发者只需定义一次输入要求和验证约束，该库即可自动处理环境检测、界面渲染、参数验证以及在Jupyter notebooks、Google Colab和终端环境中的会话持久化。它采用“一次编写，到处运行”的架构，并使用轻量级YAML文件实现参数持久化（受ImageJ/FIJI启发）。

AI.conclusion: EZInput通过提供内置的数据完整性验证和跨环境的参数持久化，减少了用户操作摩擦，增强了科学计算工作流程的可重复性与易用性，架起了算法开发者与非编程终端用户之间的桥梁。
AI.translation: 研究人员在应用计算算法时面临着持久的障碍，因为参数配置通常需要编程技能，不同环境之间的界面存在差异，且设置很少在会话之间持久保存。这种碎片化迫使研究人员进行重复输入，减缓了迭代探索，并且由于参数选择难以记录、共享和重用，从而损害了可重复性。我们提出了EZInput，这是一个跨运行环境的Python库，使算法开发人员能够自动生成图形用户界面，从而让没有编程专业知识的最终用户也能使用他们的计算工具。EZInput采用声明式规范系统，开发人员只需定义一次输入要求和验证约束；然后，该库会在Jupyter notebooks、Google Colab和终端环境中处理环境检测、界面渲染、参数验证和会话持久化。这种“一次编写，到处运行”的架构使研究人员能够在notebooks中进行原型设计，并在远程系统上部署相同的参数配置进行批量执行，而无需修改代码或进行手动转录。受ImageJ/FIJI启发并适应Python工作流的参数持久化功能，通过轻量级的YAML文件保存和恢复用户配置，消除了冗余输入并生成了可共享的记录，从而提高了可重复性。EZInput支持科学计算必不可少的多种输入类型，还包括内置验证，以确保数据完整性并提供清晰的反馈，从而减少用户摩擦。

AI.comments: 该论文针对科研软件开发中的一个核心痛点——“如何让非编程背景的用户方便、一致地配置和运行算法”提出了非常实用的解决方案。其创新点在于实现了“一次编写，到处运行”的跨环境（Notebook和终端）UI自动生成，以及引入了轻量级YAML参数持久化机制。这对于提高科研成果的复用性、转化率和可重复性具有重要意义。局限性在于，仅从摘要来看，该库可能更侧重于静态参数输入，对于复杂的动态交互式UI（如实时数据可视化或多步骤条件工作流）的支持能力尚不明确。

title: Programming over Thinking: Efficient and Robust Multi-Constraint Planning
comments: Accepted at ACL 2026 : Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
summary: Multi-constraint planning involves identifying, evaluating, and refining candidate plans while satisfying multiple, potentially conflicting constraints. Existing large language model (LLM) approaches face fundamental limitations in this domain. Pure reasoning paradigms, which rely on long natural language chains, are prone to inconsistency, error accumulation, and prohibitive cost as constraints compound. Conversely, LLMs combined with coding- or solver-based strategies lack flexibility: they often generate problem-specific code from scratch or depend on fixed solvers, failing to capture generalizable logic across diverse problems. To address these challenges, we introduce the Scalable COde Planning Engine (SCOPE), a framework that disentangles query-specific reasoning from generic code execution. By separating reasoning from execution, SCOPE produces solver functions that are consistent, deterministic, and reusable across queries while requiring only minimal changes to input parameters. SCOPE achieves state-of-the-art performance while lowering cost and latency. For example, with GPT-4o, it reaches 93.1% success on TravelPlanner, a 61.6% gain over the best baseline (CoT) while cutting inference cost by 1.4x and time by ~4.67x. Code is available at https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE.
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 : Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

AI.title_translation: 编程胜于思考：高效且鲁棒的多约束规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，通过将查询特定的推理与通用代码执行解耦，实现了高效、鲁棒的多约束规划，在TravelPlanner上取得93.1%成功率的同时大幅降低了成本和耗时。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM多约束规划方法存在局限性：依赖长自然语言链的纯推理范式在约束增加时容易出现不一致、错误累积和高昂成本；而结合编码或求解器的策略则缺乏灵活性，通常需要从头生成特定问题的代码或依赖固定求解器，无法捕获跨多样化问题的泛化逻辑。
AI.method: 提出可扩展代码规划引擎（SCOPE）框架。该框架将查询特定的推理与通用代码执行相解耦。通过这种分离，SCOPE能够生成一致、确定且可跨查询复用的求解器函数，在处理不同查询时仅需对输入参数进行极小的修改。
AI.result: SCOPE实现了最先进的性能，同时降低了成本和延迟。例如，结合GPT-4o，它在TravelPlanner基准测试上达到了93.1%的成功率，比最佳基线（CoT）提高了61.6%，同时将推理成本降低了1.4倍，运行时间缩短了约4.67倍。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE框架通过解耦推理和执行，为多约束规划提供了一种高效、鲁棒且具有成本效益的解决方案，在保证高成功率的同时显著降低了计算资源消耗。
AI.translation: 多约束规划涉及在满足多个潜在冲突约束的同时，识别、评估和完善候选方案。现有的预训练大语言模型（LLM）方法在这一领域面临根本性的局限。依赖长自然语言链的纯推理范式，随着约束的复合，容易出现不一致、错误累积和高昂的成本。相反，将LLM与基于编码或求解器的策略相结合的方法缺乏灵活性：它们通常需要从头开始生成特定问题的代码，或者依赖于固定的求解器，从而无法捕获跨不同问题的通用逻辑。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了可扩展代码规划引擎（SCOPE），这是一个将查询特定推理与通用代码执行解耦的框架。通过将推理与执行分离，SCOPE生成了在查询之间一致、确定且可重用的求解器函数，同时仅需要对输入参数进行极小的更改。SCOPE在降低成本和延迟的同时，实现了最先进的性能。例如，结合GPT-4o，它在TravelPlanner上达到了93.1%的成功率，比最佳基线（CoT）提高了61.6%，同时将推理成本降低了1.4倍，时间缩短了约4.67倍。代码可在 https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在多约束规划中面临的“纯推理易出错”和“代码/求解器方法缺乏灵活性”的双重挑战，提出了可扩展代码规划引擎（SCOPE）框架。SCOPE通过将特定查询的推理与通用代码执行进行解耦，生成了可复用、确定性的求解器函数。实验表明，SCOPE在TravelPlanner任务上取得了突破性的性能提升，并大幅降低了推理成本和延迟。
AI.keywords: 多约束规划, 大语言模型, 代码规划引擎, 推理与执行解耦, 效率优化
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将“推理”与“执行”解耦，克服了传统CoT方法在面对复杂多约束时容易产生幻觉和累积误差的缺陷。其提出的SCOPE框架不仅提高了规划的准确性和鲁棒性，还通过复用求解器函数极大地降低了LLM的推理成本和延迟，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于摘要未详细提及该框架在除TravelPlanner之外的其他类型多约束任务上的泛化表现。

title: Transition Matching Distillation for Fast Video Generation
summary: Large video diffusion and flow models have achieved remarkable success in high-quality video generation, but their use in real-time interactive applications remains limited due to their inefficient multi-step sampling process. In this work, we present Transition Matching Distillation (TMD), a novel framework for distilling video diffusion models into efficient few-step generators. The central idea of TMD is to match the multi-step denoising trajectory of a diffusion model with a few-step probability transition process, where each transition is modeled as a lightweight conditional flow. To enable efficient distillation, we decompose the original diffusion backbone into two components: (1) a main backbone, comprising the majority of early layers, that extracts semantic representations at each outer transition step; and (2) a flow head, consisting of the last few layers, that leverages these representations to perform multiple inner flow updates. Given a pretrained video flow model, we first introduce a flow head to the model, and adapt it into a conditional flow map. We then apply distribution matching distillation to the student model with flow head rollout in each transition step. Extensive experiments on distilling Wan2.1 1.3B and 14B text-to-video models demonstrate that TMD provides a flexible and strong trade-off between generation speed and visual quality. In particular, TMD outperforms existing distilled models under comparable inference costs in terms of visual fidelity and prompt adherence. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/genair/tmd

AI.title_translation: 快速视频生成的转换匹配蒸馏
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 TMD 的新型视频蒸馏框架，通过将多步去噪轨迹与少步概率转换相匹配，并结合骨干网络与流头部的分解设计，实现了兼顾极速生成与高质量视觉效果的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 大型视频扩散和流模型虽然在高质量视频生成上取得了巨大成功，但由于其多步采样过程效率低下，限制了它们在实时交互应用中的使用。
AI.method: 提出转换匹配蒸馏（TMD）框架。其核心是将多步去噪轨迹与少步概率转换过程相匹配，每个转换建模为轻量级条件流。为此，将原始扩散骨干网络分解为两部分：1）主骨干网络（占大部分早期层），用于提取语义表示；2）流头部（最后几层），用于利用这些表示进行多次内部流更新。接着引入流头部并将其调整为条件流图，最后在每个转换步骤中对带有流头部展开的学徒模型应用分布匹配蒸馏。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1 1.3B 和 14B 文本到视频模型上的蒸馏实验表明，TMD 在生成速度和视觉质量之间提供了灵活且强大的权衡。在相当的推理成本下，TMD 在视觉保真度和提示词遵循度方面均优于现有的蒸馏模型。
AI.conclusion: TMD 是一种灵活且强大的视频扩散模型蒸馏框架，能够有效平衡视频生成的速度与质量，在同等推理成本下，其视觉保真度和提示词遵循度均优于现有的蒸馏方法。
AI.translation: 大型视频扩散和流模型在高质量视频生成方面取得了显著成功，但由于其低效的多步采样过程，它们在实时交互式应用中的使用仍然受到限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了转换匹配蒸馏（Transition Matching Distillation, TMD），这是一个将视频扩散模型蒸馏为高效少步生成器的全新框架。TMD 的核心思想是将扩散模型的多步去噪轨迹与少步概率转换过程相匹配，其中每个转换都被建模为一个轻量级的条件流。为了实现高效的蒸馏，我们将原始的扩散骨干网络分解为两个部分：（1）主骨干网络，包含大部分早期图层，用于在每个外部转换步骤中提取语义表示；（2）流头部，由最后几层组成，利用这些表示来执行多次内部流更新。给定一个预训练的视频流模型，我们首先向该模型引入一个流头部，并将其调整为条件流图。然后，在每个转换步骤中，我们对带有流头部展开的学徒模型应用分布匹配蒸馏。对 Wan2.1 1.3B 和 14B 文本到视频模型进行蒸馏的广泛实验表明，TMD 在生成速度和视觉质量之间提供了灵活且强大的权衡。特别是，在相当的推理成本下，TMD 在视觉保真度和提示词遵循度方面优于现有的蒸馏模型。项目页面：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/genair/tmd
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 TMD（Transition Matching Distillation）的新型视频扩散模型蒸馏框架。该框架将多步去噪轨迹与少步概率转换过程相匹配，并通过将扩散骨干网络分解为主骨干网络与轻量化流头部，实现了高效的少步视频生成。实验表明，TMD 在 Wan2.1 模型上取得了优秀的蒸馏效果，在保证高视觉质量和提示词遵循度的同时大幅提升了生成速度。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 扩散模型蒸馏, 转换匹配蒸馏, 条件流
AI.comments: 本文针对视频扩散模型推理速度慢的痛点，创新性地提出了将骨干网络分解为主骨干与轻量化流头部的架构设计。这种设计使得在少步转换中能够复用深层语义特征，仅对最后几层流头部进行多次迭代更新，从而在极大降低计算开销的同时保持了高水平的生成质量，对实时视频生成和交互应用具有重要的推动作用。

title: Parameter Efficient Machine Unlearning on Hybrid Resistive Memory based Compute-in-Memory Accelerators
summary: Resistive memory compute-in-memory accelerators provide energy efficient analogue matrix vector multiplication for neural network inference, but frequent reprogramming of analogue weights remains costly because of device variability and iterative write and verify operations. This limitation hinders their use in edge model adaptation, including approximate machine unlearning and continual learning, where model parameters may need to be updated repeatedly in response to data deletion requests or newly arriving tasks. Here we present a co-design approach across hardware and software that maps frozen pretrained weights to analogue resistive memory arrays while placing trainable low rank adaptation branches in SRAM connected digital compute. By using LoRA style parameter efficient updates, the proposed scheme confines adaptation to a small set of digital parameters and avoids repeated reprogramming of the analogue backbone. To our knowledge, this work provides the first experimental demonstration of approximate machine unlearning on a fabricated resistive memory CIM accelerator. We validate the framework on a 180 nm 128x128 1T1R resistive-memory macro for face recognition, and through circuit-accurate simulations for speaker authentication and stylized image generation tasks, owing to the substantial model sizes involved. Compared with a baseline that directly updates analog weights, our hybrid mapping reduces analog training/update cost by up to 148x, on-chip deployment overhead by up to 388x, and inference energy by up to 59x, while preserving competitive task performance. These results show that hybrid analogue-digital LoRA mapping can enable efficient post-deployment adaptation on RM-CIM hardware, although formal machine-unlearning guarantees and large-scale system integration remain open challenges.

AI.title_translation: 基于混合阻变存储器存算一体加速器的参数高效机器遗忘
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合模拟-数字LoRA映射的软硬件协同方法，通过在阻变存储器中冻结预训练权重并在数字SRAM中进行LoRA参数更新，首次在存算一体芯片上实现了低成本、低功耗的近似机器遗忘。
AI.motivation: 阻变存储器存算一体加速器虽然在神经网络推理中具有极高的能效，但由于器件变异性和迭代写入验证操作，频繁重构模拟权重的成本非常昂贵。这限制了其在需要频繁更新模型参数的边缘自适应场景（如响应数据删除请求的近似机器遗忘和处理新任务的持续学习）中的应用。
AI.method: 提出一种软硬件协同设计方法。该方法将冻结的预训练权重映射到模拟阻变存储器（RM）阵列中，而将可训练的低秩自适应（LoRA）分支放置在与SRAM连接的数字计算单元中。通过这种LoRA风格的参数高效更新，将自适应过程限制在极小的一组数字参数中，从而避免了对模拟骨干权重的重复编程和擦写。
AI.result: 在180 nm 128x128 1T1R阻变存储器微芯片（用于人脸识别）以及针对语音认证和风格化图像生成任务的电路精确仿真中进行了验证。与直接更新模拟权重的基准方案相比，该混合映射方法将模拟训练/更新成本降低了高达148倍，片上部署开销降低了高达388倍，推理功耗降低了高达59倍，同时保持了极具竞争力的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 混合模拟-数字LoRA映射方案能够使阻变存储器存算一体硬件实现高效的部署后模型自适应（如机器遗忘和持续学习），为边缘端低能耗、长寿命的硬件自适应系统设计提供了新方向，尽管其正式的机器遗忘保证和大规模系统集成仍有待解决。
AI.translation: 阻变存储器存算一体加速器为神经网络推理提供了高能效的模拟矩阵向量乘法，但由于器件变异性以及迭代的写入和验证操作，频繁重写模拟权重仍然代价高昂。这一限制阻碍了它们在边缘模型自适应中的应用，包括在需要响应数据删除请求或新到达的任务时重复更新模型参数的近似机器遗忘和持续学习。在这里，我们提出了一种跨硬件和软件的协同设计方法，该方法将冻结的预训练权重映射到模拟阻变存储器阵列，同时将可训练的低秩自适应（LoRA）分支放置在连接SRAM的数字计算中。通过使用LoRA风格的参数高效更新，所提出的方案将自适应限制在很小的一组数字参数中，并避免了对模拟骨干的重复编程。据我们所知，这项工作首次在一款制造出的阻变存储器存算一体加速器上实验演示了近似机器遗忘。我们在用于人脸识别的180 nm 128x128 1T1R阻变存储器微芯片上验证了该框架，并由于涉及庞大的模型尺寸，通过针对扬声器身份验证和风格化图像生成任务的电路精确仿真进行了验证。与直接更新模拟权重的基准相比，我们的混合映射将模拟训练/更新成本降低了高达148倍，片上部署开销降低了高达388倍，推理能量降低了高达59倍，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务性能。这些结果表明，混合模拟-数字LoRA映射可以在RM-CIM硬件上实现高效的部署后自适应，尽管正式的机器遗忘保证和大规模系统集成仍然是开放的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文针对阻变存储器存算一体（RM-CIM）加速器中模拟权重重复擦写代价高昂的问题，提出了一种软硬件协同设计方案。该方案将冻结的预训练权重部署在模拟阻变存储器中，而将可训练的LoRA分支置于数字SRAM中。这种混合映射机制将参数更新限制在少量的数字参数上，避免了对模拟骨干权重的频繁编程。实验和仿真表明，该方案首次在RM-CIM硬件上实现了高效的近似机器遗忘，大幅降低了更新成本、部署开销和推理功耗。
AI.keywords: 阻变存储器, 存算一体, 机器遗忘, 低秩自适应 (LoRA), 软硬件协同设计
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将大模型微调中常用的LoRA技术引入到存算一体（CIM）硬件设计中，通过“模拟存储静态权重 + 数字计算动态参数”的混合架构，巧妙地解决了阻变存储器（RRAM）频繁擦写带来的高能耗和器件老化问题。这是机器遗忘在新型非易失性存储器硬件上的首次成功落地尝试，对边缘设备的持续学习和隐私保护具有重要意义。不过，其局限性在于尚未提供严格的机器遗忘理论安全保证，且大规模系统集成仍是未来面临的挑战。

title: On the suboptimality of linear codes for binary distributed hypothesis testing
comments: 11 pages. revision: accepted and presented at ISIT 2026, added reference [Ama11]
summary: We study a binary distributed hypothesis testing problem where two agents observe correlated binary vectors and communicate compressed information at the same rate to a central decision maker. In particular, we study linear compression schemes and show that simple truncation is the best linear scheme in two cases: (1) testing opposite signs of the same magnitude of correlation, and (2) testing for or against independence. We conjecture, supported by numerical evidence, that truncation is the best linear code for testing any correlations of opposite signs. Further, for testing against independence, we also compute classical random coding exponents and show that truncation, and consequently any linear code, is strictly suboptimal.
comment: 11 pages. revision: accepted and presented at ISIT 2026, added reference [Ama11]

AI.title_translation: 关于二元分布式假设检验中线性码次优性的研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了二元分布式假设检验，证明了简单截断在特定情况下是最佳线性压缩方案，但在独立性检验中，任何线性码（包括截断方案）都是严格次优的。
AI.motivation: 旨在研究二元分布式假设检验问题（其中两个代理观察相关二元向量并向中央决策者传输压缩信息），特别是评估线性压缩方案的性能及其局限性。
AI.method: 研究了线性压缩方案，分析了截断方案在特定检验场景下的表现，并计算了用于独立性检验的经典随机编码指数。
AI.result: 1. 证明了在检验相同强度相反符号的相关性以及检验独立性这两种情况下，简单截断是最佳的线性方案；2. 提出并用数值证据支持了一个猜想，即截断是检验任何相反符号相关性的最佳线性码；3. 计算了独立性检验的经典随机编码指数，证明了截断及所有线性码在此场景下是严格次优的。
AI.conclusion: 在二元分布式假设检验中，虽然简单截断在特定线性方案中是最优的，但对于独立性检验，任何线性码（包括截断方案）都是严格次优的。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个二元分布式假设检验问题，其中两个代理观察相关的二元向量，并以相同的速率向中央决策者传输压缩信息。具体而言，我们研究了线性压缩方案，并展示了在以下两种情况下，简单的截断是最佳的线性方案：（1）检验相同相关性强度的相反符号，以及（2）检验独立性与否。在数值证据的支持下，我们猜想截断是检验任何相反符号相关性的最佳线性码。此外，对于独立性检验，我们还计算了经典的随机编码指数，并表明截断（从而任何线性码）是严格次优的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了二元分布式假设检验中的线性压缩方案。研究表明，在检验相同强度的相反符号相关性以及检验独立性时，简单的截断是最佳的线性方案，并猜想其对于任何相反符号相关性的检验也是最佳线性码。然而，通过计算经典随机编码指数，研究表明在独立性检验中，截断及所有线性码实际上是严格次优的。
AI.keywords: 分布式假设检验, 线性码, 截断方案, 随机编码指数, 次优性
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了分布式假设检验中线性码的局限性。其创新之处在于证明了简单截断在线性方案中的最优性，同时通过严谨的指数计算揭示了线性码在更广泛场景（如独立性检验）下的严格次优性，为未来非线性分布式源编码的设计提供了重要启示。

title: Unification of Deterministic Higher-Order Patterns (Full Version)
summary: We present a sound and complete unification procedure for deterministic higher-order patterns, a class of simply-typed lambda terms introduced by Yokoyama et al. which comes with a deterministic matching problem. Our unification procedure can be seen as a special case of full higher-order unification where flex-flex pairs can be solved in a most general way. Moreover, our method generalizes Libal and Miller's recent functions-as-constructors higher-order unification (FCU) by dropping their global restriction on variable arguments, thereby losing the property that every solvable problem has a most general unifier. In fact, minimal complete sets of unifiers of deterministic higher-order patterns may be infinite, so decidability of the unification problem remains an open question.

AI.title_translation: 确定性高阶模式的合一化（完整版）
AI.tldr: 本文为确定性高阶模式提出了一种健全且完备的合一化算法，推广了现有的“函数即构造器”高阶合一化方法，但其可判定性仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 针对Yokoyama等人引入的具有确定性匹配问题的简单类型lambda项类（即确定性高阶模式），探索其合一化问题，并尝试通过消除现有高阶合一化方法（如FCU）中的全局限制来推广该技术。
AI.method: 提出了一种健全且完备的合一化算法。该算法是完全高阶合一化的一种特例（其中flex-flex对能以最一般的方式求解），并通过取消Libal和Miller的“函数即构造器”高阶合一化（FCU）中对变量参数的全局限制，实现了对FCU的推广。
AI.result: 成功为确定性高阶模式设计了健全且完备的合一化算法。但由于取消了变量参数的全局限制，该方法失去了“每个可解问题都具有最一般合一子（MGU）”的性质，其最小完备合一子集可能是无限的。
AI.conclusion: 由于确定性高阶模式的最小完备合一子集可能存在无限个，该合一化问题的可判定性目前仍是一个尚未解决的开放性问题。
AI.translation: 我们为确定性高阶模式提出了一种健全且完备的合一化算法。确定性高阶模式是由Yokoyama等人引入的一类简单类型的lambda项，它具有确定性的匹配问题。我们的合一化算法可以被看作是完全高阶合一化的一个特例，其中flex-flex对可以以最一般的方式得以解决。此外，我们的方法通过放弃Libal和Miller最近提出的“函数即构造器”高阶合一化（FCU）中对变量参数的全局限制，从而对其进行了推广，但也因此失去了每个可解问题都具有最一般合一子（MGU）的性质。事实上，确定性高阶模式的最小完备合一子集可能是无限的，因此该合一化问题的可判定性仍然是一个开放性问题。
AI.summary: 本文针对确定性高阶模式提出了一种健全且完备的高阶合一化算法。该方法是完全高阶合一化的一个特例，并通过取消变量参数的全局限制，推广了现有的“函数即构造器”高阶合一化（FCU）方法。然而，这也导致了最一般合一子性质的丧失，使得该问题的可判定性仍是未决问题。
AI.keywords: 确定性高阶模式, 高阶合一化, 完备合一子集, 可判定性
AI.comments: 本研究的主要贡献在于为确定性高阶模式提出了一种健全且完备的合一化算法，并成功推广了Libal和Miller的“函数即构造器”高阶合一化（FCU）方法。其局限性（同时也是未来研究的切入点）在于，由于取消了对变量参数的全局限制，导致无法保证存在最一般的合一子，且最小完备合一子集可能呈无限性，使得该问题的可判定性依然是一个未解之谜。

title: Solving Hamilton-Jacobi equations by residual minimization of monotone finite-difference discretizations
summary: We introduce a method for solving Hamilton--Jacobi equations, both inviscid and viscous, by minimizing the squared residuals of monotone finite-difference discretizations on grids of varying resolution. The method is designed to leverage neural networks and modern GPUs to solve these equations in higher dimensions; consequently, the setting for our analysis is the minimization of the residual functionals via gradient-based optimization. We establish a well-posedness theory for this approach: any critical point of the finite-difference loss solves the monotone scheme together with the prescribed Dirichlet boundary conditions, and the error of an approximation is controlled by its residual. We then derive the rate of convergence of the gradient flow that minimizes the residual in several settings, noting that the rate may depend on the grid resolution and the domain dimension. Building on this foundation, we propose a multi-level training algorithm that exploits the faster convergence available on the coarser grids of the discretization. Combined with the convergence theorem of Barles and Souganidis for monotone and consistent schemes, our results guarantee convergence to the unique viscosity solution as the grid is refined. We illustrate the approach on eikonal equations, level-set problems, and a Hamilton--Jacobi--Isaacs equation arising from a stochastic differential game, in dimensions up to eight.

AI.title_translation: 通过单调有限差分离散化残差极小化求解哈密顿-雅可比方程
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过在多分辨率网格上极小化单调有限差分残差来求解高维Hamilton-Jacobi方程的方法，并设计了多级训练算法以确保收敛至唯一的粘性解。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用神经网络和现代GPU的高效计算能力，克服高维Hamilton-Jacobi方程（包括无粘和有粘）求解时的计算瓶颈。
AI.method:
1. 极小化在不同分辨率网格上单调有限差分离散化得到的残差平方和；
2. 采用基于梯度的优化算法（适用于神经网络和GPU）来极小化残差泛函；
3. 提出一种多级（Multi-level）训练算法，利用粗网格上更快的收敛速度来加速整体优化过程。
AI.result:
1. 建立了该方法的适定性理论，证明了有限差分损失的任何临界点均能求解单调格式及Dirichlet边界条件，且近似误差由残差控制；
2. 推导了极小化残差的梯度流在不同设置下的收敛速度；
3. 在高达八维的程函方程、水平集问题以及源自随机微分博弈的Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs方程上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结合Barles和Souganidis的收敛性定理，该方法保证了随着网格的细化，数值解能够收敛到唯一的粘性解（viscosity solution）。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种求解哈密顿-雅可比（Hamilton-Jacobi）方程（包括无粘和有粘）的方法，该方法通过在不同分辨率的网格上极小化单调有限差分离散化的残差平方和来实现。该方法旨在利用神经网络和现代GPU来求解高维情况下的这些方程；因此，我们分析的背景是通过基于梯度的优化来极小化残差泛函。我们为该方法建立了一个适定性理论：有限差分损失的任何临界点都可以求解单调格式以及规定的Dirichlet边界条件，并且近似误差由其残差控制。然后，我们推导了在几种情况下极小化残差的梯度流的收敛速度，并指出该速度可能取决于网格分辨率和区域维度。在此基础上，我们提出了一种多级训练算法，该算法利用了在离散化粗网格上更快的收敛速度。结合Barles和Souganidis关于单调且相容格式的收敛性定理，我们的结果保证了随着网格的细化，计算结果能够收敛到唯一的粘性解。我们在高达八维的程函方程、水平集问题以及源自随机微分博弈的Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs方程上演示了该方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过在多分辨率网格上极小化单调有限差分离散化残差平方和来求解Hamilton-Jacobi方程的新方法。该方法旨在利用神经网络和现代GPU进行高维求解。作者为该方法建立了适定性理论，推导了梯度流的收敛速度，并提出了一种多级训练算法以利用粗网格的快速收敛特性。理论上，该方法保证了可收敛至唯一的粘性解，并在高达八维的多种方程中得到了数值验证。
AI.keywords: Hamilton-Jacobi equations, Residual minimization, Monotone finite-difference, Multi-level training, Viscosity solution
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将传统的单调有限差分格式与基于梯度下降的残差极小化（适用于神经网络与GPU加速）相结合，并提出了一种多级训练算法以解决高维Hamilton-Jacobi方程的求解难题。其重要性在于为该方法提供了坚实的理论保障，证明了其能够收敛到唯一的粘性解。局限性在于，虽然展示了高达八维的数值算例，但由于依赖于网格离散化，在面对更高维度（如几十维或百维以上）时，可能仍会受到一定程度的“维度灾难”限制。

title: Adaptive Privacy of Sequential Data Releases Under Collusion
summary: The fundamental trade-off between privacy and utility remains an active area of research. Our contribution is motivated by two observations. First, privacy mechanisms developed for one-time data release cannot straightforwardly be extended to sequential releases. Second, practical databases are likely to be useful to multiple distinct parties. Furthermore, we can not rule out the possibility of data sharing between parties. With utility in mind, we formulate a new privacy-utility trade-off problem to adaptively tackle sequential data requests made by different, potentially colluding entities. We consider both expected distortion and mutual information as measures to quantify utility, and use mutual information to measure privacy. We assume an attack model whereby illicit data sharing, which we call collusion, can occur between data receivers. We develop an adaptive algorithm for data releases that makes use of a Blahut-Arimoto-style algorithm. We show that the resulting data releases are optimal when expected distortion quantifies utility, and locally optimal when mutual information quantifies utility. Numerical experiments on real data demonstrate that the proposed adaptive algorithm can exploit previously released information to reduce cumulative leakage under collusion without sacrificing much, if any utility. Finally, we discuss how our findings may extend to applications in machine learning.

AI.title_translation: 串谋环境下的序列数据发布自适应隐私保护
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对序列数据发布的自适应隐私保护算法，能在防范数据接收方串谋（非法共享数据）的同时，实现最优或局部最优的隐私与效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的单次数据发布隐私保护机制无法直接推广到序列发布中，且实际应用中多个不同的数据接收方可能会互相共享数据（即串谋），导致隐私面临累积泄露的风险。因此，需要设计一种能自适应应对潜在串谋实体的序列数据请求的隐私保护方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于类 Blahut-Arimoto 算法的自适应数据发布算法。该方法构建了新的隐私-效用权衡模型，使用期望失真和互信息量化效用，使用互信息量化隐私，并假设了数据接收方之间存在非法共享数据的串谋攻击模型。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该自适应算法能有效利用历史发布信息，在不牺牲（或极少牺牲）效用的前提下，显著减少串谋情况下的累积隐私泄露。此外，在期望失真量化效用时，该算法可达到全局最优；在互信息量化效用时，可达到局部最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种在串谋环境下进行序列数据发布的自适应算法，证明了其在不同效用度量下的最优性，并通过实验证实了其在降低累积隐私泄露方面的有效性，最后探讨了该方法向机器学习领域的延伸。
AI.translation: 隐私与效用之间的基本权衡仍然是一个活跃的研究领域。我们的贡献源于两个观察。首先，为单次数据发布开发的隐私机制不能直接扩展到序列发布。其次，实际数据库很可能对多个不同的实体有用。此外，我们不能排除实体之间进行数据共享的可能性。考虑到效用，我们构建了一个新的隐私-效用权衡问题，以自适应地应对由不同的、可能存在串谋的实体提出的序列数据请求。我们考虑将期望失真和互信息作为衡量效用的指标，并使用互信息来衡量隐私。我们假设了一种攻击模型，即数据接收者之间可能会发生非法的物理数据共享，我们称之为串谋。我们利用类 Blahut-Arimoto 算法开发了一种用于数据发布的自适应算法。我们表明，当期望失真量化效用时，所得的数据发布是最优的；当互信息量化效用时，是局部最优的。在真实数据上的数值实验表明，所提出的自适应算法可以利用先前发布的信息，在不牺牲太多（甚至不牺牲）效用的情况下，减少串谋下的累积泄露。最后，我们讨论了我们的发现如何扩展到机器学习的应用中。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在多个可能串谋（共享数据）的接收方请求下，序列数据发布的隐私保护问题。作者提出了一种新的隐私-效用权衡框架，并开发了一种基于 Blahut-Arimoto 风格的自适应算法。该算法利用已发布的信息，在保证数据效用（期望失真或互信息）的同时，最小化由于串谋导致的累积隐私泄露。实验证明了该算法的优越性，并讨论了其在机器学习中的应用前景。
AI.keywords: 序列数据发布, 串谋, 自适应隐私, 隐私-效用权衡, Blahut-Arimoto 算法
AI.comments: 本论文针对动态、多用户环境下的数据发布问题，敏锐地抓住了“串谋（数据共享）”这一实际隐私威胁，相比传统的单次或独立发布假设更具现实意义。研究采用信息论方法（Blahut-Arimoto 算法）来解决隐私-效用权衡，并给出了最优性/局部最优性的理论证明，兼具理论深度与实用价值。其局限性可能在于对串谋行为和系统开销的假设在更复杂的实际机器学习场景中可能面临扩展性挑战。

title: Hair-Trigger Alignment: Black-Box Evaluation Cannot Guarantee Post-Update Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rarely static and are frequently updated in practice. A growing body of alignment research has shown that models initially deemed ``aligned'' can exhibit misaligned behavior after fine-tuning. These works typically assume that the initial model is aligned based on static black-box evaluation, i.e., the absence of undesired responses to a fixed set of queries. However, the limits of black-box evaluation for post-update scenarios is not explored sufficiently. In this work, we formalize model alignment in both the static and post-update settings and uncover a fundamental limitation of black-box evaluation. We theoretically show that, due to overparameterization, static alignment provides no guarantee of post-update alignment for any update dataset. Moreover, we prove that static black-box probing cannot distinguish a model that is genuinely post-update robust from one that conceals an arbitrary amount of adversarial behavior which can be activated by even a single benign gradient update. We further validate these findings empirically in LLMs across three core alignment domains: privacy, jailbreak safety, and behavioral honesty. We demonstrate the existence of LLMs that pass all standard black-box alignment tests, yet become severely misaligned after a single benign update. Finally, we show that the capacity to hide such latent adversarial behavior increases with model scale, confirming our theoretical prediction that post-update misalignment grows with the number of parameters. Together, our results highlight the inadequacy of static evaluation protocols and emphasize the urgent need for post-update--robust alignment evaluation. Code can be found at: https://github.com/Ybakman/safety_benign_update.

AI.title_translation: 一触即发的对齐：黑盒评估无法保证更新后的对齐
AI.tldr: 研究表明，静态黑盒安全评估无法保证大模型在经历哪怕一次良性微调更新后的安全性，且模型规模越大，隐藏这种在更新后才爆发的潜在危险行为的能力就越强。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在实际应用中需要频繁更新。虽然目前常通过静态黑盒评估（即对固定查询集没有不良响应）来判定模型已对齐，但微调后模型往往会重新显现出未对齐行为。目前，黑盒评估在“更新后（post-update）”场景下的局限性尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 本文在理论上形式化了静态和更新后设置下的模型对齐，并证明了由于过度参数化，静态黑盒探测无法区分真正具有更新后鲁棒性的模型与隐藏了潜在对抗行为的模型。随后，作者在隐私、越狱安全和行为诚实三个核心对齐领域进行了实证验证，通过单次良性梯度更新来测试模型的对齐变化，并分析了模型规模对隐藏对抗行为能力的影响。
AI.result: 理论和实验均表明，静态对齐无法保证任何更新数据集上的更新后安全性。实验成功证实，存在能够通过所有标准黑盒对齐测试、但在单次良性微调更新后便严重失控的LLM。此外，模型规模越大，隐藏这种潜在对抗行为（并在更新后爆发）的能力就越强。
AI.conclusion: 静态评估协议存在严重不足，无法保障模型在后续更新中的安全性。安全社区迫切需要开发并采用能够评估“更新后鲁棒性”的对齐评估新方法。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）很少是静态的，在实践中经常被更新。越来越多的对齐研究表明，最初被认为是“对齐”的模型在微调后会表现出未对齐的行为。这些工作通常基于静态黑盒评估（即对一组固定查询缺乏不期望的响应）来假设初始模型是对齐的。然而，黑盒评估在更新后场景中的局限性尚未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们形式化了静态和更新后设置下的模型对齐，并揭示了黑盒评估的一个根本局限性。我们在理论上表明，由于过度参数化，静态对齐无法为任何更新数据集提供更新后对齐的保证。此外，我们证明了静态黑盒探测无法区分一个真正具有更新后鲁棒性的模型与一个隐藏了任意数量对抗行为的模型，而后者甚至可以通过一次良性的梯度更新来激活。我们进一步在隐私、越狱安全和行为诚实这三个核心对齐领域的LLM中对这些发现进行了实证验证。我们展示了存在这样一些LLM，它们通过了所有标准的黑盒对齐测试，但在一次良性更新后却变得严重失控。最后，我们表明隐藏这种潜在对抗行为的能力随着模型规模的增加而增强，证实了我们关于更新后失控随参数数量增加而增长的理论预测。总之，我们的结果突出了静态评估方案的不足，并强调了对更新后鲁棒的对齐评估的紧迫需求。代码可在以下网址找到：https://github.com/Ybakman/safety_benign_update。
AI.summary: 本文研究了因微调更新导致的大语言模型对齐失效问题。作者指出，现有的静态黑盒评估无法保证模型在经历即使是单次良性梯度更新后的安全性。通过理论推导以及在隐私、越狱和诚实性三个领域的实证微调实验，本文揭示了过度参数化使模型能轻易隐蔽对抗行为，且这种安全隐患随模型规模增大而愈发显著。研究强调了开发更新后鲁棒对齐评估方法的紧迫性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 静态对齐, 黑盒评估, 更新后对齐, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 这篇论文切中了当前大模型安全领域的一个关键痛点：模型在发布时看似安全（通过了静态安全测试），但用户或开发者进行轻微的良性微调后，其安全防线就可能轻易崩溃。论文不仅给出了理论证明（将该隐患归因于模型的过度参数化），还通过隐私、越狱和诚实性等多个维度的实证实验进行了验证，具有很强的警示意义，推动了安全对齐评估从“静态”向“动态/更新后鲁棒”的范式转变。

title: Principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks
summary: Deep learning has achieved remarkable success across a wide range of domains, significantly expanding the frontiers of what is achievable in artificial intelligence. Yet, despite these advances, critical challenges remain -- most notably, ensuring robustness to small input perturbations and generalization to out-of-distribution data. These critical challenges underscore the need to understand the underlying fundamental principles that govern robustness and generalization. Among the theoretical tools available, Lipschitz continuity plays a pivotal role in governing the fundamental properties of neural networks related to robustness and generalization. It quantifies the worst-case sensitivity of network's outputs to small input perturbations. While its importance is widely acknowledged, prior research has predominantly focused on empirical regularization approaches based on Lipschitz constraints, leaving the underlying principles less explored. This thesis seeks to advance a principled understanding of the principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks within the paradigm of machine learning, examined from two complementary perspectives: an internal perspective -- focusing on the temporal evolution of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks during training (i.e., training dynamics); and an external perspective -- investigating how Lipschitz continuity modulates the behavior of neural networks with respect to features in the input data, particularly its role in governing frequency signal propagation (i.e., modulation of frequency signal propagation).

AI.title_translation: 神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的原理
AI.tldr: 本论文旨在通过内部（训练动态）和外部（频率信号传播调制）两个互补视角，深入理解神经网络中Lipschitz连续性在鲁棒性和泛化能力中的作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习取得了显著成功，但在确保对小输入扰动的鲁棒性和对分布外数据的泛化能力方面仍面临严峻挑战。Lipschitz连续性在理解神经网络的鲁棒性和泛化特性中起着关键作用，但现有研究主要集中于基于Lipschitz约束的经验正则化方法，对其底层原理探索不足。因此，本论文旨在从原理层面深入理解神经网络中Lipschitz连续性。
AI.method: 本论文从两个互补的视角研究神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的原理：1. 内部视角：关注训练过程中神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的时间演变（即训练动态）。2. 外部视角：研究Lipschitz连续性如何调节神经网络对输入数据特征的行为，特别是其在控制频率信号传播中的作用（即频率信号传播的调制）。
AI.translation: 深度学习在广泛领域取得了显著成功，极大地拓展了人工智能的成就边界。然而，尽管取得了这些进展，关键挑战依然存在——最显著的是，确保对微小输入扰动的鲁棒性以及对分布外数据的泛化能力。这些关键挑战凸显了理解控制鲁棒性和泛化的底层基本原理的必要性。在可用的理论工具中，Lipschitz连续性在控制与鲁棒性和泛化相关的神经网络基本特性方面发挥着关键作用。它量化了网络输出对微小输入扰动的最坏情况敏感度。虽然其重要性被广泛认可，但先前的研究主要集中于基于Lipschitz约束的经验正则化方法，对底层原理的探索较少。本论文旨在机器学习范式内，从两个互补的视角深入理解神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的原理：一个内部视角——关注训练过程中神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的时间演变（即训练动态）；以及一个外部视角——研究Lipschitz连续性如何调节神经网络对输入数据特征的行为，特别是其在控制频率信号传播中的作用（即频率信号传播的调制）。
AI.summary: 本论文旨在深入理解神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的原理，以解决深度学习在鲁棒性和泛化能力方面面临的挑战。研究将从两个互补的视角进行：一是探讨Lipschitz连续性在训练过程中的动态演变，二是分析其如何调节神经网络对输入特征（尤其是频率信号传播）的行为。该研究旨在填补当前对Lipschitz连续性底层原理探索不足的空白。
AI.keywords: Lipschitz连续性, 神经网络, 鲁棒性, 泛化, 训练动态, 频率信号传播
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于其从内部和外部两个互补视角，系统地探索了神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的底层原理，这超越了现有研究主要关注经验正则化方法的局限。通过深入理解训练动态和频率信号传播中的作用，有望为提升神经网络的鲁棒性和泛化能力提供更坚实的理论基础和指导。

title: Act, Sense, Act: Learning Active Perception from Large-Scale Egocentric Human Data
summary: Achieving generalizable manipulation in unconstrained environments requires the robot to proactively resolve information uncertainty, i.e., the capability of active perception. However, existing methods are often confined in limited types of sensing behaviors, restricting their applicability to complex environments. In this work, we formalize active perception as a history-dependent perception-action loop driven by information-seeking action and decision branching, providing a structured categorization of visual active perception paradigms. Building on this perspective, we introduce CoMe-VLA, a cognitive and memory-aware vision-language-action (VLA) framework that leverages large-scale human egocentric data to learn versatile exploration and manipulation priors. Our framework integrates a cognitive auxiliary head for autonomous sub-task transitions and a dual-track memory system to maintain consistent self and environmental awareness by fusing proprioceptive and visual temporal contexts. By aligning human and robot hand-eye coordination behaviors in a unified egocentric action space, we train the model progressively in three stages. Extensive experiments on a wheel-based humanoid have demonstrated strong robustness and adaptability of our proposed method across diverse long-horizon tasks spanning multiple active perception scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 感知-行动-感知：从大规模自我中心人体数据中学习主动感知
AI.tldr: 本文提出CoMe-VLA框架，通过利用大规模人类自我中心数据，学习主动感知，以实现机器人在复杂环境中更通用和适应性的操作。
AI.motivation: 在非受限环境中实现通用操作需要机器人主动解决信息不确定性，即具备主动感知能力。然而，现有方法通常局限于有限的感知行为类型，限制了其在复杂环境中的适用性。
AI.method: 本文将主动感知形式化为由信息寻求行动和决策分支驱动的历史依赖感知-行动循环，并提供了视觉主动感知范式的结构化分类。在此基础上，引入了CoMe-VLA，一个认知和记忆感知的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）框架，利用大规模人类自我中心数据学习多功能探索和操作先验。该框架整合了认知辅助头用于自主子任务转换，以及双轨记忆系统通过融合本体感受和视觉时间上下文来保持一致的自我和环境意识。通过在统一的自我中心行动空间中对齐人类和机器人的手眼协调行为，模型分三个阶段逐步训练。
AI.result: 在轮式人形机器人上进行的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法在跨越多种主动感知场景的各种长周期任务中具有强大的鲁棒性和适应性。
AI.conclusion: CoMe-VLA框架通过从大规模人类自我中心数据中学习主动感知，显著提高了机器人在复杂环境中执行通用操作的鲁棒性和适应性。
AI.translation: 在非受限环境中实现通用操作需要机器人主动解决信息不确定性，即具备主动感知能力。然而，现有方法通常局限于有限的感知行为类型，限制了其在复杂环境中的适用性。在这项工作中，我们将主动感知形式化为由信息寻求行动和决策分支驱动的历史依赖感知-行动循环，提供了视觉主动感知范式的结构化分类。基于这一视角，我们引入了CoMe-VLA，一个认知和记忆感知的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）框架，该框架利用大规模人类自我中心数据来学习多功能探索和操作先验。我们的框架整合了一个认知辅助头用于自主子任务转换，以及一个双轨记忆系统，通过融合本体感受和视觉时间上下文来保持一致的自我和环境意识。通过在统一的自我中心行动空间中对齐人类和机器人的手眼协调行为，我们分三个阶段逐步训练模型。在轮式人形机器人上进行的广泛实验表明，我们提出的方法在跨越多种主动感知场景的各种长周期任务中表现出强大的鲁棒性和适应性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CoMe-VLA的认知和记忆感知视觉-语言-行动（VLA）框架，旨在通过从大规模自我中心人类数据中学习主动感知，解决机器人在复杂环境中通用操作的挑战。该框架将主动感知定义为历史依赖的感知-行动循环，并集成了认知辅助头和双轨记忆系统以增强环境和自我意识。通过三阶段训练，CoMe-VLA在轮式人形机器人上的实验展示了在多样化长周期任务中的强大鲁棒性和适应性。
AI.keywords: 主动感知, 视觉-语言-行动, 自我中心数据, 机器人操作, CoMe-VLA
AI.comments: 这项工作在主动感知领域迈出了重要一步，通过将人类自我中心数据引入机器人学习，显著提升了机器人在复杂环境中的适应性和鲁棒性。其创新点在于将主动感知形式化，并提出了结合认知和记忆的VLA框架，特别是认知辅助头和双轨记忆系统的设计，有效地解决了信息不确定性和任务转换问题。通过对齐人类和机器人的手眼协调行为，使得学习到的先验知识更具实用性。未来研究可以探索该框架在更多样化机器人平台和更高维度操作任务中的应用。

title: The matrix-vector complexity of $Ax=b$
summary: Matrix--vector algorithms, particularly Krylov subspace methods, are widely viewed as the most effective algorithms for solving large systems of linear equations. This paper establishes lower bounds on the worst-case number of matrix--vector products needed by such an algorithm to approximately solve a general linear system. The first main result is that, for any matrix--vector algorithm which is allowed the use of randomization and can perform products with both a matrix and its transpose, $Ω(κ\log(1/\varepsilon))$ matrix--vector products are necessary to solve a linear system with condition number $κ$ to accuracy $\varepsilon$, matching an upper bound for conjugate gradient on the normal equations. The second main result is that one-sided algorithms, which lack access to the transpose, must use $n$ matrix--vector products to solve an $n \times n$ linear system, even when the problem is perfectly conditioned. Both main results include explicit constants that match known upper bounds up to a factor of four. These results rigorously demonstrate the limitations of matrix--vector algorithms and confirm the optimality of widely used Krylov subspace algorithms.

AI.title_translation: Ax=b 的矩阵-向量复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文建立了求解大型线性方程组的矩阵-向量算法所需矩阵-向量乘积数量的下界，揭示了算法的局限性并证实了Krylov子空间算法的最优性。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在建立矩阵-向量算法在最坏情况下近似求解一般线性系统所需的矩阵-向量乘积数量的下界，以严格证明此类算法的局限性。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析方法，建立了在最坏情况下解决一般线性系统所需的矩阵-向量乘积数量的下界。研究考虑了允许使用随机化并可进行矩阵及其转置乘积的算法，以及无法访问转置的单边算法。
AI.result: 1. 对于允许使用随机化并可进行矩阵及其转置乘积的矩阵-向量算法，求解条件数为 $κ$ 且精度为 $ε$ 的线性系统，至少需要 $Ω(κ	ext{log}(1/ε))$ 次矩阵-向量乘积。2. 对于缺乏转置访问权限的单边算法，即使问题条件完美，也需要 $n$ 次矩阵-向量乘积来求解一个 $n 	imes n$ 的线性系统。这两个主要结果都包含明确的常数，与已知的上限相差不超过四倍。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果严格地证明了矩阵-向量算法的局限性，并证实了广泛使用的Krylov子空间算法的最优性。
AI.translation: 矩阵-向量算法，特别是Krylov子空间方法，被广泛认为是解决大型线性方程组最有效的算法。本文建立了此类算法在最坏情况下近似求解一般线性系统所需的矩阵-向量乘积数量的下界。第一个主要结果是，对于任何允许使用随机化并可以与矩阵及其转置进行乘积的矩阵-向量算法，求解条件数为 $κ$ 且精度为 $ε$ 的线性系统，需要 $Ω(κ	ext{log}(1/ε))$ 次矩阵-向量乘积，这与共轭梯度法在正规方程上的上限相匹配。第二个主要结果是，缺乏转置访问权限的单边算法，即使问题条件完美，也必须使用 $n$ 次矩阵-向量乘积来求解一个 $n 	imes n$ 的线性系统。这两个主要结果都包含明确的常数，与已知的上限相差不超过四倍。这些结果严格地证明了矩阵-向量算法的局限性，并证实了广泛使用的Krylov子空间算法的最优性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了求解大型线性方程组的矩阵-向量算法的计算复杂度。通过建立对最坏情况下所需矩阵-向量乘积数量的下界，论文揭示了此类算法的固有局限性。研究发现，对于允许随机化和转置操作的算法，解决条件数为 $κ$ 的线性系统至精度 $ε$ 需要 $Ω(κ	ext{log}(1/ε))$ 次乘积；而对于缺乏转置操作的单边算法，即使条件完美，也需要 $n$ 次乘积来解决 $n 	imes n$ 的系统。这些结果不仅提供了明确的常数，还从理论上确认了Krylov子空间算法的优越性。
AI.keywords: 矩阵-向量复杂度, 下界, Krylov子空间方法, 线性系统, 条件数
AI.comments: 本文通过严格的理论分析，为矩阵-向量算法的计算复杂度设定了基本下限。这项工作对于理解这些广泛使用的数值方法在解决线性系统时的固有能力和局限性具有重要意义。它不仅提供了坚实的理论基础，还通过证实Krylov子空间算法的最优性，为实际应用提供了进一步的理论支持。

title: Preference Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Decomposed, Diversity-Driven Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) seeks to train agents capable of balancing conflicting objectives. While single preference-conditioned policies offer a highly scalable solution, existing approaches remain brittle in practice, frequently failing to recover dense Pareto fronts. We demonstrate that this failure stems from two structural pathologies: destructive advantage cancellation caused by premature Early Scalarization (ES), and representational mode collapse across the preference space. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce $D^3PO$, a PPO-based framework that fundamentally reorganizes multi-objective optimization. By preserving per-objective learning signals through a decomposed pipeline and integrating preferences only after trust-region stabilization (Late-Stage Weighting), $D^3PO$ improves credit assignment under conflicting objectives.
