title: Tactile Genesis: Exploring Tactile Sensors at Scale for Learning Dexterous Tasks
summary: Tactile sensing is critical for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, yet it remains unclear which tactile abstractions a policy needs and when richer tactile fields justify their hardware cost. This is hard to study empirically: each sensor effectively defines a new robot, and no lab can replicate the same learning experiment across all of them. We present Tactile Genesis, a GPU-parallel tactile sensor simulation platform that exposes binary contact, contact depth, per-taxel kinematic force/torque, elastomer marker displacement, geometry-aware proximity, contact audio, and a voxelized temperature field (the first of its kind in robot learning physics simulation platforms) under a common interface, with configurable placement, resolution, and a realistic noise model (drift, hysteresis, dead taxels, crosstalk). It scales past 20,000 parallel environments and 1,000 taxels on a single GPU, improving throughput by 3 to 20 times over previous tactile simulators. We train teacher-student policies on three dexterous tasks, ablating sensor type, placement, resolution, and noise, and verify transfer to the real XHand1. Proprioception alone is insufficient on every task. Sensor placement dominates sensor type: fingertip-only coverage trails whole-hand coverage by a wide margin, while adding the palm and proximal phalanges closes most of the gap to the privileged teacher. Resolution matters far less than coverage: placing 200 taxels across the whole hand suffices across tasks. We find that force/torque per taxel is consistently the most useful sensor type. These results give concrete guidance for both future tactile hardware design for improving robot hands and policy-side observation choice in dexterous manipulation. https://neuroagents-lab.github.io/tactile-genesis/

title: 3D Masked Autoencoders are Robust Learners of Volumetric and Multimodal Cellular Representations for Microscopy
summary: Self-supervised learning in fluorescence microscopy often relies on 2D projections, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of cells. We present a systematic comparison of 2D and 3D masked autoencoders (MAE-2D vs. MAE-3D) on volumetric microscopy data. Under matched architectures and training protocols, MAE-3D consistently outperforms 2D max-projection and slice-based variants on downstream single-cell tasks. We further align visual representations with a pretrained protein language model (ESM2) and show that cross-modal supervision yields larger gains for volumetric models. Channel cross-attention and frequency-domain regularization are critical for leveraging 3D spatial context. On protein--protein interaction prediction, our best model achieves a ROC--AUC of 0.86, while on protein localization it reaches an AUC$_{\text{micro}}$ of 0.95 and an F1$_{\text{micro}}$ of 0.74, demonstrating competitive performance on both tasks. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of volumetric modeling and multimodal alignment for representation learning in single-cell microscopy.

title: The Serialized Bridge: Understanding and Recovering LLM Serving Performance under Blackwell GPU Confidential Computing
summary:
GPU Confidential Computing (GPU-CC) now preserves GPU-local performance: on NVIDIA B300, BF16 matmul runs at 0.998x of non-confidential performance. Yet LLM serving under Intel TDX plus GPU-CC still loses 13-27% of throughput, and KV-cache restore latency can more than double. This paper studies that gap on two Blackwell platforms, RTX Pro 6000 and B300 HGX, and identifies its dominant cause: the confidential VM-GPU bridge, not GPU compute.
  We find that GPU-CC turns host/device movement into a serialized, high-setup-cost channel. Secure copies do not gain CUDA-stream concurrency within a context, asynchronous transfers block at the runtime boundary, and small crossings pay a fixed toll. This violates the assumptions of modern inference runtimes, where DMA is expected to be cheap, concurrent, and asynchronous. In vLLM dense decode, the gap closes around 44x-slower small alloc-and-copy operations; targeted patches reject alternative explanations. A scheduling flag recovers 57% of the gap, while a worker-thread drain recovers up to 92% in qualified high-concurrency runs. The same bridge model explains a +131% KV-restore penalty and a 34x model-load slowdown.
  Blackwell also changes the confidential tenancy unit. We qualify confidential multi-GPU NVSwitch tenants on B300, including 510 GB/s NVLink P2P inside a CVM and concurrent isolated tenants, and identify the remaining fabric-attestation gap for production confidential AI platforms.

title: Towards Continuous Power Forecasting: Practical Continual Learning for Real-World Energy Systems in Nonstationary Time Series
comments: Accepted by the joint workshop at ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Power forecasting models deployed in real-world energy markets must operate under nonstationary conditions, where data distributions continually evolve due to weather variability, infrastructure upgrades, and changing consumption behaviors. In practice, these models face strict operational constraints: historical data may be limited or unavailable for repeated retraining, and uninterrupted long-term service is often required. This paper addresses these challenges by proposing the paradigm of Continuous Power Forecasting, which views power forecasting as a continual learning problem rather than a static offline task. Based on an adaptive continual learning framework for regression, we systematically investigate the practical effectiveness of six representative continual learning approaches from three methodological categories. These approaches are evaluated under different realistic assumptions regarding data accessibility and update policies. Experimental validation on real-world power datasets demonstrates that continual learning enables forecasting models to self-adapt to distributional drift, accumulate knowledge over time, and mitigate catastrophic forgetting without relying on large-scale historical data storage. Beyond performance gains, our study provides practical insights into the stability and adaptation behaviors of different continual learning approaches under realistic operational constraints. Overall, this work illustrates how continual learning can be pragmatically integrated into industrial power forecasting pipelines, offering a scalable and sustainable solution for long-term deployment in dynamic environments.
comment: Accepted by the joint workshop at ECML PKDD 2026

title: Exploring the Intrinsic Geometry of Diffusion Models with Constrained Inverse Kinematics
comments: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026 Workshop on Diffusion for Robot Learning
summary: Recent studies suggest that diffusion models can recover geometric structure in the data manifolds they are trained on, yet the supporting evidence has so far come mostly from natural-image data, where the underlying geometry itself is unknown. We study this question in a setting where the geometry is analytically tractable: constrained inverse kinematics (IK). Each task-space constraint defines a configuration-space manifold with known intrinsic dimension, giving direct ground truth for evaluating the geometry learned by the model. For each of the 6-DoF UR5 and 7-DoF Franka, we train a single conditional diffusion model across seven constraint families, spanning solution manifolds from discrete IK branches to self-motion manifolds. Our empirical results reveal that the intrinsic dimension recovered from the model's score function matches the analytical degrees of freedom of the corresponding constraint manifold across both robots. Moreover, linear interpolation in the latent space leads to generated solutions that remain close to the appropriate constraint manifold, indicating that the learned representation further captures geometric structure of the constraint family beyond intrinsic dimension alone. Constrained IK therefore offers a controlled setting for studying the intrinsic geometry learned by diffusion models.
comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026 Workshop on Diffusion for Robot Learning

title: Estimation-Prediction Tradeoff in Causal Probabilistic Temporal Graphs
summary: Temporal link prediction (TLP) is typically evaluated by predictive performance on unseen edges, but this criterion can conflate predictive accuracy with recovery of the underlying causal mechanism. In stochastic models, Fisher information governs the Cramér--Rao (CR) bound on parameter estimation error: higher Fisher information permits more accurate parameter recovery. We show that, under comonotonicity conditions between Fisher information and entropy, binary logistic models exhibit an estimation--prediction tradeoff: regimes with higher Fisher information, and hence smaller CR bounds, also have higher irreducible predictive entropy. To study this tradeoff in TLP, we introduce a probabilistic causal generator for temporal graphs with transient edges and known ground-truth causal structure, and validate the phenomenon empirically.

AI.title_translation: 因果概率时序图中的估计-预测权衡

title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation
summary: Scaling imitation learning requires large datasets, yet human teleoperation inevitably produces mixed-quality demonstrations containing hesitations and recoveries. Prior frame-level progress reward models supervise on absolute temporal progress proxies that suffer from label noise, or require costly human annotations to define subtask boundaries. We present WARP (Warp-Augmented Relative Progress), a novel fully self-supervised algorithm for learning dense, signed relative progress magnitudes directly from successful demonstrations. WARP generates per-frame progress targets via time-warp augmentations of demonstrations (variable playback speeds and reversals) and we train WARP-RM to predict the normalized elapsed time between input frames. Aggregating these predictions across overlapping windows yields a dense frame-level progress signal. We then introduce WARP-BC, which leverages these scalar reward estimates to upweight high-advantage action chunks during behavior cloning, where chunk-level advantage is obtained by aggregating per-frame rewards. We evaluate our approach on a physical bimanual robot system performing a long-horizon deformable object manipulation task: folding T-shirts from a random crumpled start. To evaluate policy robustness against suboptimal data, we construct training datasets of varying quality using episode length as a proxy for teleoperation sub-optimality. As the dataset is widened to admit more inefficiencies, WARP-BC maintains a 19/20 success rate compared to vanilla BC's collapse to 2/20, improving throughput by up to 18x. Furthermore, we evaluate a bottle-in-bin placement task in the real-world, as well as in a reproducible simulation of the task, where gains in success, speed, and throughput hold under paired significance tests, and we release all simulation code and evaluation artifacts. Project page: https://uynitsuj.github.io/warp-rm/

AI.title_translation: WARP-RM：用于数据整理的时间规整增强相对进度奖励模型
AI.tldr: WARP-RM 通过自监督的时间规整增强学习相对进度，用于在行为克隆中对高质量动作块进行加权，从而在含有低效演示的数据集上显著提升机器人策略的成功率和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 规模化模仿学习需要大量数据，但人类遥操作产生的演示质量参差不齐（包含犹豫和恢复动作）。现有的帧级进度奖励模型要么依赖存在标签噪声的绝对时间进度代理，要么需要昂贵的人工标注来划分主任务边界。
AI.method: 提出 WARP（时间规整增强相对进度）算法，这是一种完全自监督的方法。它通过时间规整增强（可变播放速度和反转）生成每帧进度目标，并训练 WARP-RM 来预测输入帧之间的归一化流逝时间。通过在重叠窗口上聚合这些预测，得到密集的帧级进度信号。进一步提出 WARP-BC，在行为克隆期间利用这些标量奖励估计来上调高优势动作块（通过聚合每帧奖励获得块级优势）的权重。
AI.result: 在双臂机器人折T恤任务中，当训练集包含更多低效演示时，WARP-BC 保持了 19/20 的成功率，而普通行为克隆（BC）崩溃至 2/20，吞吐量提升高达 18 倍。在真实世界和仿真环境中的瓶子放入箱子任务中，成功率、速度和吞吐量均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: WARP-RM 能够有效地从混合质量的遥操作数据中学习密集的相对进度奖励，并通过加权高优势动作显著提高行为克隆策略对低效/亚优数据的鲁棒性、成功率和吞吐量。
AI.translation: 规模化模仿学习需要庞大的数据集，然而人类遥操作不可避免地会产生质量参差不齐的演示，其中包含犹豫和恢复过程。以往的帧级进度奖励模型监督于绝对时间进度代理，这会受到标签噪声的影响，或者需要昂贵的人工标注来定义子任务边界。我们提出了 WARP（时间规整增强相对进度），这是一种全新的、完全自监督的算法，直接从成功的演示中学习密集的、带符号的相对进度幅度。WARP 通过演示的时间规整增强（可变播放速度和反转）生成每帧进度目标，并且我们训练 WARP-RM 来预测输入帧之间的归一化流逝时间。在重叠窗口上聚合这些预测可以产生密集的帧级进度信号。随后，我们引入了 WARP-BC，它利用这些标量奖励估计在行为克隆过程中对高优势动作块进行加权，其中块级优势是通过聚合每帧奖励获得的。我们在执行长程柔性物体操作任务（从随机褶皱初始状态折叠 T 恤）的双臂物理机器人系统上评估了我们的方法。为了评估策略对亚优数据的鲁棒性，我们使用回合长度作为遥操作亚优性的代理，构建了不同质量的训练数据集。随着数据集扩大以容纳更多低效数据，WARP-BC 保持了 19/20 的成功率，而普通的行为克隆（BC）则崩溃至 2/20，吞吐量提升了高达 18 倍。此外，我们在真实世界以及可复现的该任务仿真中评估了瓶子入箱放置任务，在配对显著性检验下，成功率、速度和吞吐量的提升均成立，并且我们发布了所有的仿真代码和评估工件。
AI.summary: 本文针对模仿学习中人类遥操作演示质量不一的问题，提出了一种自监督的相对进度奖励模型 WARP-RM。该方法通过对成功演示进行时间规整增强（如变速和反转），训练模型预测帧间相对时间进度。在此基础上，WARP-BC 利用该进度信号对行为克隆中的高优势动作块进行加权。实验表明，在包含大量低效或亚优动作的数据集上，该方法能够显著提升机器人在长程操作任务（如折叠T恤和瓶子放置）中的成功率、速度和吞吐量，表现出极强的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, 数据整理, 进度奖励模型, 时间规整, 行为克隆
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用了时间规整增强（Time-warp Augmentation）来解决自监督进度学习中的标签噪声问题，避免了繁重的人工子任务标注。通过将学到的进度奖励转化为行为克隆中的动作块权重（WARP-BC），成功地在含有噪声/低效的人类演示数据上训练出了鲁棒的策略。其在物理双臂机器人上的折叠T恤等长程、形变物体操作任务上的显著提升，证明了该方法的实用价值和鲁棒性。

title: Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention: Bounded Editable Memory with a Hard Lifecycle and Calibrated Sparse Fallback
comments: 17 pages, 5 figures, Audit-corrected revision of the previous version. This revision adds preregistered Track A and Track B evaluations, corrected data and statistical protocols, artifact-sourced figures, and a full disclosure of the original budget-gate failure and forward-only adjudication. All backbones are frozen; no leaderboard or systems-superiority claim is made
summary: We study memory-managed long-context attention: explicit bounded memory with a learned query-independent writer, lifecycle control, query-aware reading, calibrated sparse fallback, and frozen-LLM generation from raw evidence. Track A is a controlled versioned-variable task where last-mention retrieval is wrong by construction. Its full lifecycle scores 1.000 on all three seeds versus a 0.333 lexical baseline, and generation reaches 300/300 at 146 prompt tokens, compared with 172/300 for full-context reading at 729 tokens. Track B uses held-out HotpotQA questions and train-derived, answer-excluded distractors at natural and 8.2k-word lengths. A learned two-hop selector with a bounded 32-passage cache and fallback beats dense retrieval by 5.5--16.6 F1 and reaches 102--116% of full-context F1 at 10% of the evidence words. These real-text gains come from the learned selector; the cache preserves quality at a 0--2.9 F1 cost, and static QA text does not exercise overwrite or protection. The original Llama budget gate failure and the forward-adjudicated Qwen follow-up are reported explicitly. All backbones are frozen; joint training, faithful architecture baselines, and systems measurements remain future work.

AI.title_translation: 内存管理的长上下文注意力机制：具有硬生命周期和校准稀疏回退的有界可编辑内存
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种内存管理的长上下文注意力机制，通过具有显式生命周期控制的有界内存和稀疏回退，在仅使用约10% Token开销的情况下，实现了超越全上下文阅读和稠密检索的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决大语言模型（LLM）在处理长上下文时面临的计算与显存开销巨大的问题，探索如何通过显式、有界且可编辑的内存管理机制来高效存储、更新和检索长文本中的关键信息。
AI.method: 提出“内存管理的长上下文注意力机制”（Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention），其包含显式有界内存、学得的查询无关写入器、生命周期控制、查询感知读取、校准稀疏回退，并基于原始证据进行冻结LLM生成。设计了两个评估轨道：Track A（受控版本变量任务，测试生命周期控制）和 Track B（基于HotpotQA的多跳问答，使用学得的双跳选择器和32通道有界缓存）。
AI.result: 在Track A中，该方法的完整生命周期在三个种子上均获得1.000的满分（词法基线为0.333），且在仅146个提示词Token下实现了300/300的完美生成，而全上下文在729个Token下仅为172/300。在Track B中，配备32通道缓存和回退的学得双跳选择器比稠密检索高出5.5至16.6 F1值，并在仅用10%证据词的情况下达到了全上下文F1值的102%至116%。
AI.conclusion: 内存管理的长上下文注意力机制（尤其是学得的双跳选择器与有界缓存）能够以极少的Token开销（如仅10%的证据词）提供比肩甚至超越全上下文阅读的性能。然而，联合训练、更具代表性的动态任务测试以及系统级性能测量仍是未来亟待解决的问题。
AI.translation: 我们研究了内存管理的长上下文注意力机制：具有学得的查询无关写入器、生命周期控制、查询感知读取、校准稀疏回退以及基于原始证据的冻结大语言模型（LLM）生成的显式有界内存。轨道 A 是一个受控的版本变量任务，在该任务中，按构建设计，最后一次提及检索是错误的。其完整生命周期在所有三个种子上的得分均为 1.000，而词法基线仅为 0.333；并且在 146 个提示词 Token 下生成达到了 300/300，相比之下，在 729 个 Token 下的全上下文阅读仅达到 172/300。轨道 B 使用了留出的 HotpotQA 问题以及从训练中导出的、排除答案的自然长度及 8.2k 词长度的干扰项。一个配备了有界 32 通道缓存和回退的学得双跳选择器，其性能比稠密检索高出 5.5 到 16.6 F1 值，并在仅使用 10% 证据词的情况下达到了全上下文 F1 值的 102% 到 116%。这些在真实文本上的提升源于学得的选择器；缓存以 0 到 2.9 F1 的微小性能损失保留了质量，而静态 QA 文本并未激发重写或保护机制。文中明确报告了原始 Llama 预算门失效以及前向判定的 Qwen 后续工作。所有骨干网络均被冻结；联合训练、忠实的架构基线和系统测量仍属于未来的工作。
AI.summary: 本文研究了一种内存管理的长上下文注意力机制，通过引入显式有界内存、生命周期控制、查询感知读取和校准稀疏回退，实现了高效的长文本信息处理。实验表明，该方法在受控的版本变量任务和HotpotQA多跳问答任务中表现优异，在大幅减少输入Token数的同时，性能不仅超越了词法和稠密检索基线，甚至超越了全上下文阅读。
AI.keywords: 长上下文注意力, 有界内存, 稀疏回退, 生命周期控制, 信息检索
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的内存管理注意力机制，其创新点在于引入了具有生命周期控制的显式有界内存和校准稀疏回退，这为解决大模型在极长上下文下的显存和计算开销问题提供了新思路。然而，其局限性在于所有骨干网络均处于冻结状态，尚未进行端到端的联合训练，且静态QA测试集未能充分激活内存的重写与保护机制，实际系统层面的吞吐与延迟测量仍有待未来工作完善。

title: Do Recommendation Algorithms Work When Users Are LLM Agents? A Case Study on Moltbook
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly populating web platforms, raising a fundamental question for recommender systems: do algorithms designed for human users still work when users are LLM agents that may not have well-defined content consumption preferences? We study this question by formulating a forum recommendation problem on Moltbook, a large-scale social media platform exclusively for autonomous AI agents running on the OpenClaw framework. We evaluate nine recommendation methods spanning simple heuristic rules, matrix factorization, itemand user-based collaborative filtering, graph-based, and sequential models on the task of predicting which forums an agent will engage with next.
  We find that simple popularity-based rules or item-side collaborative filtering leveraging the platform and item structural information outperform techniques that explicitly learn a user representation. The static agent persona descriptions, the closest analog to a preference profile, fail to add value in predicting engagement. These results suggest that, on Moltbook, recommendation depends more on platform- and item-level structural signals than on user-specific personalization. We present multiple lines of empirical evidence that the observed content consumption patterns on Moltbook differ from well-established findings on human recommendation datasets, providing a new angle for studying agent societies and designing robust recommendation algorithms as agents increasingly populate the web.

AI.title_translation: 当用户是大语言模型智能体时，推荐算法还能起作用吗？基于 Moltbook 的案例研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了传统推荐算法在以大语言模型智能体为用户的平台（Moltbook）上的表现，发现基于流行度或物品侧协同过滤的简单规则优于个性化推荐，揭示了智能体与人类在内容消费模式上的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体在网络平台上的日益普及，推荐系统面临一个根本性问题：当用户是不具备明确内容消费偏好的 LLM 智能体时，专为人类设计的推荐算法是否仍然有效？
AI.method: 在专为自主 AI 智能体设计的社交媒体平台 Moltbook 上构建论坛推荐问题。评估了九种推荐方法，包括简单启发式规则、矩阵分解、基于物品和用户的协同过滤、基于图的模型以及序列模型，用于预测智能体接下来会参与哪个论坛。
AI.result: 简单的基于流行度的规则或利用平台和物品结构信息的物品侧协同过滤，其表现优于显式学习用户表示的技术；静态的智能体角色描述（最接近偏好画像的特征）在预测参与度时未能提供增值作用；Moltbook 上的内容消费模式与人类推荐数据集中的既有发现存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 在 Moltbook 平台上，推荐更依赖于平台和物品层面的结构信号，而非针对用户的个性化。这为研究智能体社会以及在智能体日益增多的网络环境中设计鲁棒的推荐算法提供了新的视角。
AI.translation:
大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地涌现于网络平台，这给推荐系统提出了一个根本性的问题：当用户是可能没有明确内容消费偏好的 LLM 智能体时，专为人类用户设计的算法是否仍然有效？我们通过在 Moltbook 上构建一个论坛推荐问题来研究这一课题，Moltbook 是一个专门为运行在 OpenClaw 框架上的自主 AI 智能体打造的大型社交媒体平台。我们评估了九种推荐方法，涵盖简单的启发式规则、矩阵分解、基于物品和用户的协同过滤、基于图的模型以及序列模型，任务是预测智能体下一步会参与哪个论坛。
我们发现，简单的基于流行度的规则或利用平台和物品结构信息的物品侧协同过滤，其表现优于显式学习用户表示的技术。静态的智能体角色描述（最接近偏好画像的特征）在预测参与度时未能提供任何增值。这些结果表明，在 Moltbook 上，推荐更多地依赖于平台和物品层面的结构信号，而非针对用户的个性化。我们提供了多条实证证据，表明在 Moltbook 上观察到的内容消费模式与人类推荐数据集中公认的发现有所不同，这为研究智能体社会以及在智能体日益占据网络空间的背景下设计鲁棒的推荐算法提供了新的视角。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了传统推荐系统在由 LLM 智能体组成的社交平台（Moltbook）上的适用性。通过测试九种不同的推荐算法，研究发现针对人类设计的、依赖于显式用户画像和个性化表征的算法在智能体平台上面临挑战，而基于物品结构和流行度的简单方法表现更好。这一发现揭示了 AI 智能体与人类在内容消费行为上的本质区别。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 推荐系统, 协同过滤, 智能体社会, Moltbook
AI.comments: 这是一篇极具前瞻性和创新性的论文。随着 Agent 技术的爆发，未来互联网中 Agent 之间的交互和消费行为将大幅增加，研究“给 Agent 做推荐”是一个非常新颖且重要的课题。论文的局限性可能在于 Moltbook 平台本身的规则和 OpenClaw 框架下智能体的行为设定可能无法完全代表未来所有真实的智能体社会，但它依然迈出了探索该领域的重要一步。

title: Smooth Scaling Laws Hide Stepwise Token Learning
summary: Language model loss follows remarkably regular scaling laws over model and data size, yet it remains unclear why the aggregate loss should exhibit a power-law form. Existing explanations often attribute this regularity to a heavy-tailed spectrum of pattern difficulty in natural language, but this view has not been directly validated at token-level granularity in large-scale real-data training. We present a token-level framework that decomposes scaling laws into localized learning events of individual contextualized tokens. By fitting token loss trajectories with sigmoids, we show that token learning is concentrated in localized transitions, giving rise to a learning-time spectrum that dominates the scaling-law shape. Across more than one hundred pre-training runs on large and diverse real-language corpora with modern LLM architectures, scaling up to 6B parameters and 300B training tokens, the measured learning-time spectrum quantitatively reconstructs the validation loss derivative along the training-step $T$, data-scale $D$, and model-scale $M$ axes. We further show that the same signal is actionable: by reshaping the training distribution according to when tokens become learnable, we alter the optimization trajectory and achieve 11\% faster validation-loss reduction. These results provide direct empirical evidence that scaling laws are governed primarily by the distribution of token-level learning times, and that this distribution can be used not only to explain scaling behavior but also to improve training performance.

AI.title_translation: 平滑的缩放定律隐藏了逐步的词元学习
AI.tldr: 语言模型的平滑缩放定律本质上是由单个词元在特定时间点发生阶跃式学习的分布决定的；利用这一微观规律重塑训练数据分布，可将模型训练效率提升11%。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型的总损失遵循规律的幂律缩放定律，但其背后的机制仍不清楚。现有解释通常归因于自然语言模式难度的重尾分布，但这一观点在真实的大规模数据训练中尚未在词元（token）级别得到直接和定量的验证。
AI.method: 提出了一个词元级框架，将平滑的缩放定律分解为单个上下文词元的局部学习事件。通过使用S型曲线（sigmoid）拟合词元的损失轨迹，展示词元学习集中在局部转变中，从而构建出“学习时间谱”。此外，基于词元变得可学习的时间点来重塑训练数据的分布，以优化训练过程。
AI.result: 在超过100次预训练运行（最高达6B参数和300B词元）中，测得的学习时间谱定量地重构了验证损失在训练步数、数据规模和模型规模轴上的导数。基于该发现重塑训练分布，成功改变了优化轨迹，并实现了验证损失下降速度提升11%。
AI.conclusion: 缩放定律主要由词元级别的学习时间分布决定。该分布不仅可以用来解释宏观的缩放行为，还可以用于指导训练分布的重塑，从而切实提高大语言模型的训练性能。
AI.translation: 语言模型的损失在模型和数据规模上遵循非常规律的缩放定律，但目前尚不清楚为什么总体损失会呈现幂律形式。现有的解释通常将这种规律性归因于自然语言中模式难度的重尾谱，但这一观点尚未在大规模真实数据训练中在词元级别得到直接验证。我们提出了一个词元级别的框架，将缩放定律分解为单个上下文词元的局部学习事件。通过用S型曲线拟合词元损失轨迹，我们展示了词元学习集中在局部转变中，从而产生了一个主导缩放定律形状的学习时间谱。通过在大型且多样化的真实语言语料库上使用现代大语言模型架构进行的一百多次预训练运行（规模高达60亿参数和3000亿训练词元），测得的学习时间谱定量地重构了验证损失在训练步数 $T$、数据规模 $D$ 和模型规模 $M$ 轴上的导数。我们进一步表明，相同的信号是可操作的：通过根据词元变得可学习的时间来重塑训练分布，我们改变了优化轨迹，并实现了验证损失下降速度加快 11%。这些结果提供了直接的经验证据，表明缩放定律主要由词元级学习时间的分布决定，并且该分布不仅可以用来解释缩放行为，还可以用来提高训练性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了语言模型平滑缩放定律背后的微观机制，发现宏观的平滑损失曲线实际上是由单个词元在训练中发生局部阶跃式学习的“学习时间谱”叠加而成的。作者通过百余次大规模预训练定量重构了缩放定律的导数，并利用该机制通过重塑训练分布实现了11%的训练加速。
AI.keywords: 缩放定律, 词元级学习, 学习时间谱, 语言模型预训练
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将宏观、平滑的语言模型缩放定律（Scaling Laws）拆解到了微观、离散的词元（token）级别，打破了以往仅从宏观统计视角解释缩放定律的局限。其重要性在于不仅提供了坚实的经验证据和定量的重构，还证明了这种微观机制具有实践指导意义（通过重塑训练分布加速11%的训练）。局限性在于，虽然在现代LLM架构上进行了广泛测试，但重塑训练分布的具体策略在更大规模（如超千亿参数）或更复杂任务上的通用性和计算开销仍需进一步探讨。

title: PRISM: Latent Composition Consistency for Single-Image Reflection Removal
summary: Single-image reflection removal (SIRR) seeks to recover the transmission layer from a mixture corrupted by reflections -- a severely ill-posed problem. Existing methods operate in pixel space, where the nonlinear sRGB formation model entangles the two layers and limits generalization. We observe that pretrained VAE latent spaces exhibit substantially lower coherence between image layers compared to pixel space, providing a more favorable working space for decomposition. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{PRISM} (Pretrained-latent Reflection Image Separation Model), which reinterprets SIRR as a latent linear separation problem. Under an approximate additive formulation in latent space, PRISM learns a flow matching velocity field on a pretrained FLUX backbone that recovers both transmission and reflection in a single forward pass. To enforce robust disentanglement, we introduce a Latent Composition Consistency (LCC) strategy that constructs synthetic mixtures by swapping reflection latents across samples and enforces consistent decomposition via a cycle loss. We further propose a Layer Contrastive Separation (LCS) loss that promotes semantic separation between layers through patch-level contrastive learning, without requiring explicit reflection targets. Experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins, with strong generalization to in-the-wild images.

AI.title_translation: PRISM：用于单幅图像反射去除的潜空间组合一致性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了PRISM，将单图像反射去除重新定义为预训练VAE潜空间中的线性分离问题，通过流匹配、潜空间组合一致性（LCC）和层对比分离（LCS）损失，实现了高效、高质量的反射与透射层单次前向传播分离。
AI.motivation: 单图像反射去除（SIRR）是一个严重病态的问题。现有方法在像素空间中运行，由于非线性sRGB成像模型导致透射层与反射层严重纠缠，限制了模型的泛化能力。而预训练VAE潜空间中图像层之间的相干性显著低于像素空间，为层分解提供了更有利的运行空间。
AI.method:
提出PRISM模型：
1. 将单图像反射去除建模为预训练VAE潜空间中的近似线性分离问题，在预训练的FLUX骨干网络上学习流匹配（flow matching）速度场，单次前向传播即可同时恢复透射和反射层。
2. 引入潜空间组合一致性（LCC）策略，通过跨样本交换反射潜变量构建合成混合物，并利用循环一致性损失强制实现鲁棒的解耦。
3. 提出层对比分离（LCS）损失，利用块级对比学习促进两层之间的语义分离，无需显式的反射目标。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，PRISM在性能上持续且显著地超越了现有的最先进（SOTA）方法，并且对自然真实图像（in-the-wild images）表现出极强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将单图像反射去除任务重新定义为预训练VAE潜空间中的线性分离问题，并结合LCC和LCS等约束机制，可以实现比传统像素空间方法更优异、泛化性更强的反射去除效果。
AI.translation: 单幅图像反射去除（SIRR）旨在从受到反射污染的混合图像中恢复出透射层，这是一个严重的病态问题。现有的方法通常在像素空间中运行，其中非线性的sRGB成像模型使得这两个图层纠缠在一起，从而限制了泛化能力。我们观察到，与像素空间相比，预训练的VAE潜空间在图像层之间表现出显著更低的相干性，这为分解提供了一个更有利的运行空间。基于这一发现，我们提出了PRISM（预训练潜空间反射图像分离模型），将SIRR重新解释为潜空间中的线性分离问题。在潜空间中的近似加性公式下，PRISM在预训练的FLUX骨干网络上学习流匹配速度场，从而在单次前向传播中同时恢复透射层和反射层。为了增强鲁棒的解耦能力，我们引入了一种潜空间组合一致性（LCC）策略，该策略通过跨样本交换反射潜变量来构建合成混合物，并通过循环损失来强制实现一致的分解。我们还进一步提出了一种层对比分离（LCS）损失，通过块级对比学习来促进层之间的语义分离，而不需要显式的反射目标。在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，PRISM的性能持续且显著地优于现有最先进的方法，并且对自然真实图像具有极强的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PRISM的单图像反射去除新方法。该方法利用预训练VAE潜空间中图像层相干性较低的特点，将反射去除任务转化为潜空间中的线性分离问题。通过在FLUX骨干网络上应用流匹配，并结合潜空间组合一致性（LCC）循环损失和层对比分离（LCS）损失，PRISM能够在单次前向传播中高效、鲁棒地分离出透射层和反射层，在多个基准测试中取得了领先的性能。
AI.keywords: 单图像反射去除, 潜空间分离, 流匹配, 组合一致性, 对比学习
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于打破了传统在像素空间处理反射去除的局限，敏锐地观察到预训练VAE潜空间中图像层相干性较低的特性，从而将复杂的非线性sRGB解耦问题简化为潜空间中的近似线性分离。通过结合流匹配技术、潜空间组合一致性（LCC）循环约束以及无需显式反射目标的层对比分离（LCS）损失，该方法不仅在理论上十分优雅，而且在六个基准测试上取得了显著的性能提升，表现出极强的泛化能力。

title: ECHO: Prune To Act, Trace To Learn With Selective Turn Memory In Agentic RL
summary: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by simplifying past interactions through deletion, folding, or memory editing. However, when useful history is collapsed into compressed states, the reconstructed context may no longer reveal which earlier observations support a successful final answer. This creates a mismatch between bounded-context acting and outcome-based reinforcement learning: the policy acts on reconstructed context, while the learner lacks source-level provenance for assigning credit to the evidence that mattered. We propose ECHO, a selective turn-memory framework for traceable context reconstruction in Agentic RL. ECHO compresses each completed environment turn into a compact source-indexed memory record, reconstructs bounded policy contexts by selecting useful records, and reuses the selected source indices to route positive outcome credit to the final trajectory segment, reused evidence turns, memory findings, and memory-selection actions. On BrowseComp-Plus, ECHO reaches 43.4% held-out accuracy, outperforming GRPO at 28.9% and the rolling-summary baseline SUPO at 36.1%, while using fewer turns and lower trajectory volume than SUPO. The trained policy also improves zero-shot generalization across multi-objective QA, code generation, and deep information-seeking benchmarks on both dense and MoE backbones.

AI.title_translation: ECHO：在Agent强化学习中通过选择性轮次记忆进行“剪枝以行动，追踪以学习”
AI.tldr: ECHO引入了一种选择性轮次记忆框架，通过源索引机制实现可追溯的上下文重建，解决了长程Agent强化学习中的信用分配难题，显著提升了任务效率与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体在受限的上下文窗口下，通常需要压缩或简化过去的历史交互。然而，这种压缩会导致重建的上下文丢失源头信息，使得强化学习算法无法准确地将信用（credit）分配给真正起作用的早期观察，造成了受限上下文行动与基于结果的强化学习之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 提出ECHO框架，其主要步骤包括：1. 将每个完成的环境轮次压缩为紧凑且带源索引的记忆记录；2. 通过选择有用的记录来重建受限的策略上下文；3. 重用所选的源索引，将正向结果信用精准路由到最终的轨迹片段、重用的证据轮次、记忆发现以及记忆选择动作中。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus基准上，ECHO达到了43.4%的留出准确率，显著优于GRPO（28.9%）和滚动摘要基准SUPO（36.1%），同时使用的轮次和轨迹量更少。此外，该方法在稠密和MoE骨干网络上，均提升了在多目标问答、代码生成和深度信息检索等基准任务上的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ECHO通过可追溯的上下文重建和选择性轮次记忆，成功解决了长程语言智能体在受限上下文中的信用分配难题，不仅显著提升了任务成功率，还具有极佳的零样本泛化能力。
AI.translation: 长程语言智能体（Agent）必须反复与工具交互、积累证据，并在受限的上下文窗口下做出决策。上下文管理方法通过删除、折叠或记忆编辑来简化过去的交互，从而使这种长程展开（rollouts）成为可能。然而，当有用的历史被压缩为紧凑状态时，重建的上下文可能无法再揭示哪些早期的观察支持了成功的最终答案。这导致了受限上下文行动与基于结果的强化学习之间的不匹配：策略在重建的上下文上做出行动，而学习器缺乏源头级别的溯源，无法将信用（credit）分配给真正起作用的证据。我们提出了 ECHO，一个在智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）中用于可追溯上下文重建的选择性轮次记忆框架。ECHO 将每个完成的环境轮次压缩为紧凑的、带源索引的记忆记录，通过选择有用的记录来重建受限的策略上下文，并重复使用所选的源索引，将正向结果信用路由到最终的轨迹片段、重用的证据轮次、记忆发现以及记忆选择动作。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，ECHO 达到了 43.4% 的留出准确率，优于 GRPO（28.9%）和滚动摘要基准 SUPO（36.1%），同时比 SUPO 使用了更少的轮次和更低的轨迹量。训练后的策略在稠密和 MoE 骨干网络上的多目标问答、代码生成和深度信息检索基准测试中，也提高了零样本泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对长程语言智能体在受限上下文窗口下面临的信用分配难题，提出了ECHO框架。ECHO通过选择性轮次记忆和源索引机制重建可追溯的上下文，将最终的正面结果反馈精准分配给关键的历史证据与选择决策。实验表明，ECHO在任务准确率、资源消耗及多任务零样本泛化性上均优于现有基准方法。
AI.keywords: 智能体强化学习, 信用分配, 上下文重建, 选择性记忆, 长程智能体
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将上下文管理与强化学习中的信用分配（Credit Assignment）问题结合起来，通过源索引机制解决了“哪些历史信息对最终成功有贡献”的溯源问题。这一设计非常巧妙，既缓解了长上下文的计算与存储压力，又提升了强化学习在长程任务中的训练效率，对构建实用、高效的长程Agent具有重要参考价值。

title: Temporal Path Covers: Dilworth Properties and Parameterized Complexity
summary:
The Minimum Temporal Path Cover (TPC) and Minimum Temporally Disjoint Path Cover (TDPC) problems were introduced by [Chakraborty, Dailly, Foucaud, Klasing, MFCS '24]. Both were shown to be NP-hard on temporal DAGs, while the latter is also NP-hard on temporal oriented trees. All tractable cases for T(D)PC established in that paper satisfy a temporal Dilworth property, namely that the size of the minimum T(D)PC is equal to the size of the maximum antichain. This raises a natural question: is T(D)PC polynomial-time solvable under the promise that the respective Dilworth property holds? In this work, we answer this question in the affirmative for both problems, proving in fact that, under the respective promise, the size of the minimum T(D)PC is exactly equal to the Lovász number of the connectivity graph.
  In another direction, we establish parameterized algorithms and hardness results for TPC and TDPC. Our main result is that TPC is W[1]-hard parameterized by the deletion distance to linear forest even for temporal graphs with two time-steps, answering in the negative an open question by Chakraborty et al. about whether an XP algorithm parameterized by treewidth plus number of time-steps can be improved to FPT. On the other hand, we prove that an FPT algorithm does exist if the vertex cover number is used as parameter instead of the treewidth in the above parameterization. We complement this with a proof that including the number of time-steps in the parameter is necessary to yield tractability, as, otherwise, both TPC and TDPC remain NP-hard even for constant vertex cover size. Along the way, we establish various other para-NP-hardness results involving structural parameters such as the pathwidth and the maximum degree of the underlying graph.

AI.title_translation: 时序路径覆盖：Dilworth性质与参数化复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在时序Dilworth性质下最小路径覆盖问题可在多项式时间内求解，并通过划定FPT与W[1]-困难性边界，全面解析了该问题的参数化复杂度，否定回答了前人的一项公开问题。
AI.motivation: 前人研究表明，最小时序路径覆盖（TPC）和最小时序不相交路径覆盖（TDPC）在时序DAG上是NP-难的，但其所有已知的易解实例都满足时序Dilworth性质（即最小覆盖大小等于最大反链大小）。这激发了两个研究动机：一是探究在Dilworth性质成立的前提下，这两个问题是否有多项式时间算法；二是深入研究它们的参数化复杂度，特别是解决前人留下的关于是否存在FPT算法的公开问题。
AI.method:
1. 理论证明方法：通过将满足时序Dilworth性质的最小T(D)PC的大小与底层连通图的Lovász数建立等价关系，证明其多项式时间可解性。
2. 参数化复杂度分析：采用还原（Reductions）方法证明W[1]-困难性和para-NP-困难性；利用参数化算法设计技术（针对顶点覆盖数和时间步数）构建FPT算法。
AI.result:
1. 证明了在Dilworth性质承诺下，最小T(D)PC的大小恰好等于连通图的Lovász数，从而可在多项式时间内求解。
2. 证明了即使在只有两个时间步的时序图上，以“到线性森林的删除距离”为参数时，TPC也是W[1]-困难的，否定地回答了关于“树宽+时间步数”是否存在FPT算法的公开问题。
3. 证明了若将参数替换为“顶点覆盖数+时间步数”，则存在FPT算法。
4. 证明了参数中必须包含时间步数，否则即使顶点覆盖大小为常数，TPC和TDPC仍为NP-困难。
5. 确立了涉及路径宽度和底层图最大度等其他结构参数的para-NP-困难性结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了在时序Dilworth性质成立的前提下，TPC和TDPC均可在多项式时间内求解。同时，通过展示W[1]-困难性、设计FPT算法以及证明若干para-NP-困难性结果，全面描绘了这两个问题在各种结构参数与时间步数组合下的参数化复杂度蓝图。
AI.translation:
最小时序路径覆盖（TPC）和最小时序不相交路径覆盖（TDPC）问题由 [Chakraborty, Dailly, Foucaud, Klasing, MFCS '24] 提出。这两个问题在时序DAG上均被证明是NP-难的，而后者在时序有向树上也是NP-难的。该论文中确立的所有易解的T(D)PC实例都满足时序Dilworth性质，即最小T(D)PC的大小等于最大反链的大小。这提出了一个自然的问题：在各自的Dilworth性质成立的承诺下，T(D)PC是否是多项式时间可解的？在这项工作中，我们对这两个问题都给出了肯定的回答，实际上证明了在相应的承诺下，最小T(D)PC的大小恰好等于连通图的Lovász数。
在另一个方向上，我们确立了TPC和TDPC的参数化算法与硬度结果。我们的主要结果是，即使对于只有两个时间步的时序图，以到线性森林的删除距离为参数时，TPC也是W[1]-困难的，从而否定地回答了Chakraborty等人提出的一个公开问题，即以树宽加上时间步数为参数的XP算法是否可以改进为FPT。另一方面，我们证明了如果在上述参数化中，使用顶点覆盖数代替树宽作为参数，则确实存在FPT算法。我们还证明了在参数中包含时间步数是实现易解性所必需的，因为否则，即使顶点覆盖大小为常数，TPC和TDPC仍然是NP-难的。在此过程中，我们还确立了涉及结构参数（如路径宽度和底层图的最大度）的其他各种para-NP-困难性结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了最小时序路径覆盖（TPC）和最小时序不相交路径覆盖（TDPC）问题的计算复杂度。作者首先证明了在Dilworth性质成立的前提下，这两个问题均可在多项式时间内求解，且其解的大小等于对应连通图的Lovász数。随后，作者对这两个问题的参数化复杂度进行了系统分析，证明了以到线性森林的删除距离为参数时TPC是W[1]-困难的（否定回答了前人公开问题），但若以顶点覆盖数和时间步数为联合参数则存在FPT算法，并给出了其他若干关于路径宽度和最大度的硬度边界。
AI.keywords: 时序路径覆盖, Dilworth性质, 参数化复杂度, Lovász数, W[1]-困难性
AI.comments: 本文在时序图路径覆盖（TPC/TDPC）领域取得了重要的理论突破。其主要创新点在于：第一，巧妙地将时序Dilworth性质与图论中的Lovász数建立联系，从而优雅地解决了Dilworth承诺下的多项式时间可解性问题；第二，对参数化复杂度进行了极其细致的刻画，通过证明W[1]-困难性否定回答了前人关于“树宽+时间步数”参数下是否存在FPT算法的公开问题，并给出了基于顶点覆盖数的FPT算法。这些结果清晰地标定了该问题在不同结构参数下的计算边界，具有很高的学术价值。

title: Iterated Invariant EKF for 3D Landmark-Aided Inertial Navigation
summary: Inertial navigation systems aided by three-dimensional landmark measurements constitute a fundamental problem in robotic perception and state estimation. Classical SO(3)-based Extended Kalman Filter (SO(3)-EKF) approaches provide practical solutions, but suffer from the false observability problem, in which the filter becomes overconfident in unobservable directions, leading to degraded estimation performance. The Invariant EKF (IEKF) addresses this limitation by reformulating the system dynamics as a group-affine system on a Lie group, although its measurement update does not fully satisfy certain state compatibility properties. More recently, the Iterated Invariant EKF (IterIEKF) was proposed to further improve the IEKF by ensuring, in the low-noise regime, that the estimated state remains on the observed state manifold while the uncertainty is confined to its tangent space. In this work, we formulate and apply the IterIEKF to landmark-based inertial 3D localization for the first time. Through numerical simulations, we show that the proposed approach outperforms the classical SO(3)-EKF, the Iterated SO(3)-EKF, and the IEKF in terms of both estimation accuracy and consistency.

AI.title_translation: 用于三维地标辅助惯性导航的迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波
AI.tldr: 本文首次将迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF）应用于三维地标辅助惯性定位，通过解决虚假可观测性及状态兼容问题，显著提升了估计精度和一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于SO(3)的扩展卡尔曼滤波（SO(3)-EKF）存在虚假可观测性问题，导致滤波器在不可观测方向上过度自信并降低估计性能；而不变卡尔曼滤波（IEKF）的测量更新则未能完全满足特定的状态兼容性质。
AI.method: 首次将迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF）公式化并应用于基于地标的惯性三维定位中。该方法通过确保在低噪声情况下估计状态保持在观测状态流形上，并将不确定性限制在其切空间内，从而对传统的IEKF进行了改进。
AI.result: 数值仿真结果表明，所提出的IterIEKF方法在估计精度和一致性两个指标上，均优于传统的SO(3)-EKF、迭代SO(3)-EKF以及标准的IEKF。
AI.conclusion: IterIEKF在三维地标辅助惯性定位中表现出比传统SO(3)-EKF、迭代SO(3)-EKF以及IEKF更优越的估计精度和一致性，是解决该领域虚假可观测性及不确定性约束问题的有效方案。
AI.translation: 辅助以三维地标测量的惯性导航系统是机器人感知和状态估计中的一个基本问题。传统的基于SO(3)的扩展卡尔曼滤波（SO(3)-EKF）方法提供了实用的解决方案，但存在虚假可观测性问题，即滤波器在不可观测的方向上过度自信，导致估计性能下降。不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IEKF）通过将系统动力学重新表述为李群上的群仿射系统来解决这一局限性，尽管其测量更新并不完全满足某些状态兼容性。最近，有人提出了迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF），通过确保在低噪声情况下估计状态保持在观测状态流形上，同时将不确定性限制在其切空间内，从而进一步改进IEKF。在这项工作中，我们首次将IterIEKF公式化并应用于基于地标的惯性三维定位。通过数值仿真，我们表明所提出的方法在估计精度和一致性方面都优于传统的SO(3)-EKF、迭代SO(3)-EKF和IEKF。
AI.summary: 本文针对三维地标辅助惯性导航系统，首次引入并应用了迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF）。该方法旨在解决传统SO(3)-EKF的虚假可观测性问题以及IEKF在测量更新时的不兼容缺陷。通过将估计状态约束在观测状态流形上并限制其不确定性，IterIEKF在仿真中展现出了比对比算法更高的估计精度与一致性。
AI.keywords: 迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波, 惯性导航, 三维地标定位, 状态估计, 虚假可观测性
AI.comments: 本论文将最新的迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF）理论首次引入到三维地标辅助惯性导航领域，具有较强的学术和应用价值。它有效克服了传统SO(3)-EKF的虚假可观测性缺陷，并弥补了IEKF在测量更新时状态兼容性的不足。虽然其验证目前主要依赖于数值仿真，但其在估计精度和一致性上的显著提升为后续实际机器人定位系统的应用奠定了坚实的基础。

title: CORGI: Consistency-Aware 3D Dog Reconstruction from a Single Image in the Wild
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D models of highly articulated animals, such as dogs, from a single in-the-wild image remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we introduce CORGI, a novel framework for consistency-aware 3D dog reconstruction from a single unconstrained image that completely eliminates the need for 3D supervision. To overcome generative inconsistencies and the lack of multi-view capture, our pipeline introduces three core components. First, we propose a Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation (CDOG) strategy, utilizing specialized Canonical and Orbit LoRAs to normalize arbitrary input poses and synthesize reliable 360-degree video observations. Second, we design a Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS (CA-3DGS) module that anchors on a D-SMAL prior, explicitly modeling per-view generative errors through dedicated neural deformation fields to learn accurate vertex-level displacements. Finally, to eliminate structural distortions and recover high-frequency details, we introduce a self-supervised Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair (DCGR) module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORGI achieves state-of-the-art performance, generalizing seamlessly across diverse dog breeds to produce geometrically accurate, visually coherent, and fully animatable 3D assets ready for downstream applications.

AI.title_translation: CORGI：基于单张野外图像的3D犬只一致性重建
AI.tldr: CORGI提出了一个新颖的框架，无需3D监督即可从单张野外图像重建高保真、可动画的3D犬只模型。
AI.motivation: 从单张野外图像重建高度铰接动物（如狗）的高保真3D模型仍然是一个艰巨的挑战，尤其是在缺乏多视角捕获和生成不一致性的情况下。
AI.method: CORGI是一个新颖的一致性感知3D犬只重建框架，无需3D监督。它包括三个核心组件：1. 规范驱动的轨道生成（CDOG）策略，利用专门的规范和轨道LoRAs来标准化姿态并合成360度视频观测。2. 一致性感知可变形3DGS（CA-3DGS）模块，锚定在D-SMAL先验上，通过神经变形场建模每个视角的生成错误，学习顶点级位移。3. 自监督的变形条件生成修复（DCGR）模块，用于消除结构变形和恢复高频细节。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，CORGI实现了最先进的性能，能够无缝地推广到不同的犬种，生成几何精确、视觉连贯且完全可动画的3D资产，可用于下游应用。
AI.conclusion: CORGI成功地从单张野外图像中重建出高保真、几何精确、视觉连贯且完全可动画的3D犬只模型，无需3D监督，并能泛化到多种犬种，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 从单张野外图像重建高度铰接动物（如狗）的高保真3D模型仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了CORGI，一个新颖的框架，用于从单张无约束图像进行一致性感知3D犬只重建，完全无需3D监督。为了克服生成不一致性和多视角捕获的缺乏，我们的管道引入了三个核心组件。首先，我们提出了一种规范驱动的轨道生成（CDOG）策略，利用专门的规范和轨道LoRAs来标准化任意输入姿态并合成可靠的360度视频观测。其次，我们设计了一个一致性感知可变形3DGS（CA-3DGS）模块，该模块锚定在D-SMAL先验上，通过专门的神经变形场明确建模每个视角的生成错误，以学习准确的顶点级位移。最后，为了消除结构变形并恢复高频细节，我们引入了一个自监督的变形条件生成修复（DCGR）模块。广泛的实验表明，CORGI实现了最先进的性能，无缝地推广到不同的犬种，生成几何精确、视觉连贯且完全可动画的3D资产，可用于下游应用。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CORGI，一个新颖的框架，旨在从单张野外图像重建高保真、可动画的3D犬只模型，且无需3D监督。为解决生成不一致性和多视角数据缺乏的问题，CORGI提出了三个核心组件：规范驱动的轨道生成（CDOG）策略用于合成360度观测；一致性感知可变形3DGS（CA-3DGS）模块用于学习精确的顶点级位移；以及自监督的变形条件生成修复（DCGR）模块用于细节恢复。实验证明，CORGI实现了最先进的性能，能够生成几何精确、视觉连贯且可动画的3D资产，并适用于多种犬种。
AI.keywords: 3D犬只重建, 单张图像, 一致性感知, 3DGS, 可动画资产
AI.comments: CORGI在3D重建领域取得了显著进展，它通过消除对3D监督和多视角捕获的需求，解决了现实世界场景中的一个关键限制。其模块化设计，包括CDOG、CA-3DGS和DCGR组件，为实现一致性、准确性和细节恢复提供了一个全面的解决方案。该方法能够泛化到多种犬种并生成可动画的资产，这使其具有高度创新性，对各种下游应用都具有重要意义。

title: When to Repair a Graph ANN Index: A Matched-Budget Negative Result, and the Interpolated-Baseline Trap That Hid It
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures. v2 is a substantial correction: v1's main result and mechanism claim are withdrawn. v1 compared against an interpolated, never-executed fixed-cadence baseline; running it erases the effect. Four pre-registered controls, asserted in v1 as passing, were unimplemented; all now run, and budget parity fails. Code: https://github.com/samyama-ai/updatable-graph-index
summary: Graph approximate-nearest-neighbor (ANN) indexes (HNSW, DiskANN/Vamana) lose recall under insert/delete churn, because deletions orphan the greedy-search paths that route through removed nodes. Production systems restore navigability by repairing the graph on a fixed schedule (consolidate every X operations). We asked whether triggering local edge repair on a measured navigability-degradation signal, rather than a blind clock, spends a fixed repair budget better. At matched repair budget, it does not. On two real ANN datasets (SIFT-128 and Fashion-MNIST-784) under a bursty churn stream, compared against a fixed-cadence baseline actually run at the triggered policy's realized consolidation count, the tail-recall advantage is indistinguishable from zero at every operating point, graph degree, and index scale; at several points the clock is better. We trace our earlier positive result to an interpolated baseline: recall is sharply concave in repair budget -- one consolidation captures over half of all achievable gain -- so reading the baseline off a straight line between zero and four passes understates it by more than the effect claimed. Evaluated by the statistic we pre-registered -- correlation with the subsequent recall drop rather than with the concurrent recall level -- the probe signal is also not a leading indicator. What remains is useful: an exact live-set recall oracle, a reproducible churn harness, a drift-severity regime map, and a budget-parity protocol that makes this error detectable. We report the negative result and the trap, because the trap generalizes: any "at matched budget X" comparison whose baseline is read off an interpolated curve, at the scarce end of a concave response, will manufacture an effect favouring the proposal.

Four pre-registered controls, asserted in v1 as passing, were unimplemented; all now run, and budget parity fails. Code: https://github.com/samyama-ai/updatable-graph-index

AI.title_translation: 何时修复图ANN索引：一个等预算下的否定结果，以及隐藏该结果的插值基线陷阱
AI.tldr: 在相同预算下，基于退化信号触发的图ANN索引修复并不优于固定周期修复；此前相反的结论源于“插值基线陷阱”，该陷阱会因基线低估而制造出方案更优的假象。
AI.motivation: 图近似最近邻（ANN）索引在频繁插入和删除的动态场景下会因路径断裂而丢失召回率。生产系统通常采用固定周期的盲目时钟进行修复，本研究旨在探究在相同的修复预算下，基于导航退化信号触发的局部修复是否比固定周期修复更高效。
AI.method: 在两个真实ANN数据集（SIFT-128和Fashion-MNIST-784）的突发动态变化流下，将“基于退化信号触发的局部边缘修复策略”与“实际运行相同巩固次数的固定周期基线”进行等预算对比；并利用预先注册的统计指标（与后续召回率下降的相关性）评估探测信号。
AI.result: 在等预算下，触发式修复的尾部召回率优势与零无异，在某些操作点上固定时钟甚至表现更好。之前得出的积极结论被证实是因为“插值基线陷阱”（召回率对修复预算呈强凹性，线性插值低估了基线）。此外，探测信号也并非后续召回率下降的领先指示器。
AI.conclusion: 在等预算条件下，基于信号触发的图ANN索引修复并不优于传统的固定周期修复。研究警示了“插值基线陷阱”的普遍存在性：在性能随预算呈凹函数变化的场景下，使用插值基线会低估基线表现，从而人为制造出有利于新方案的假象。
AI.translation: 图近似最近邻（ANN）索引（如HNSW、DiskANN/Vamana）在插入/删除的动态变化（churn）下会丢失召回率，因为删除操作会使通过已被移除节点的贪婪搜索路径断开。生产系统通过按固定计划修复图（每隔X次操作进行一次整合）来恢复可导航性。我们探究了在固定的修复预算下，基于测量的导航退化信号触发局部边缘修复，是否比盲目的时间钟表现更好。在等预算下，答案是否定的。在两个真实的ANN数据集（SIFT-128和Fashion-MNIST-784）处于突发动态变化流的情况下，与在触发策略实际实现的整合次数下运行的固定节奏基线相比，在每个操作点、图度和索引规模上，尾部召回率优势与零无异；在几个点上，固定时钟的表现甚至更好。我们将我们早期得到的积极结果追溯到插值基线：召回率对修复预算呈急剧的凹函数关系——一次整合就占了所有可实现收益的一半以上——因此在零到四次通过之间的直线上读取基线会低估基线，低估幅度超过了声称的效果。根据我们预先注册的统计数据（与后续召回率下降的相关性，而不是与并发召回率水平的相关性）进行评估，探测信号也不是一个领先指标。剩下的是有用的成果：一个精确的活跃集召回率预测器、一个可复现的动态变化测试框架、一个漂移严重性区域图，以及一个使这种错误可检测的预算对等协议。我们报告了这个否定结果和这个陷阱，因为该陷阱具有普适性：任何在凹响应的稀缺端、其基线是从插值曲线中读取的“在匹配预算X下”的对比，都会制造出一种有利于所提方案的假象。
AI.summary: 本文针对图近似最近邻（ANN）索引在动态增删场景下的修复时机展开研究。作者对比了“基于导航退化信号触发的修复”与“固定周期修复”在相同预算下的表现，得出了一个否定结果：触发式修复并无优势。作者进一步揭示了导致先前错误积极结论的“插值基线陷阱”——由于召回率对修复预算呈凹性响应，通过插值估算基线会严重低估基线性能。文章最后提供了一套防范此类实验误差的预算对等协议及测试工具。
AI.keywords: 图ANN索引, 索引修复, 否定结果, 插值基线陷阱, 预算对等协议
AI.comments: 本文具有极高的学术严谨性与反思精神，作者勇于发表“否定结果”（Negative Result）并推翻自己先前的结论，这在当前学术界非常难得。文章深刻揭示了“插值基线陷阱”（Interpolated-Baseline Trap），这一方法论上的发现具有很强的普适性，能为其他涉及“等预算对比”的计算机系统实验设计提供重要警示。其局限性可能在于主要针对特定图ANN索引和数据集，但其提出的预算对等协议和开源工具具有很高的实用价值。

title: The Decode-Work Law: Margin-Governed, Provably-Exact Spatial Joins over Compressed Geometry
comments: 8 pages, 2 figures. v2: headline unchanged, better supported. v1 claimed to count LOD header bytes and did not; now charged to all methods (byte advantage 2.02x -> 1.91x; progressive loses at 0.99x on the adversarial fixture). Five pre-registered controls, none reported in v1, are now reported; the relabel null confirms the law. Code: https://github.com/samyama-ai/spatial-join-on-compressed
summary: Filter-and-refine spatial joins have always avoided touching exact geometry for certified candidate pairs, but the field never modeled the decompression cost of the pairs that survive the filter. When geometry is stored in a compressed, progressively-decodable multiresolution codec, the join's true cost is bytes decoded. We study provably-exact polygon intersection joins over a Douglas-Peucker level-of-detail (LOD) ladder, certified by a two-sided Hausdorff-margin test, and make two contributions. First, a reproducible mechanism and harness: on real U.S. Census TIGER water polygons, our progressive certificate join returns the exact join result while decoding 3.4-16.8x (median 5.9x) fewer vertices than naive decompress-then-refine, and about 4.9x fewer than the single-approximation multi-step baseline of Brinkhoff et al. (1994), with zero correctness violations (set-equality against a full-precision oracle) across 31 workloads. Second, a characterization we call the decode-work law: decode work is governed by each pair's signed-clearance margin -- how close it is to the predicate-flip boundary -- independent of object size, because the certificate descends the ladder only until its resolution beats the margin. The law is clean on controlled geometry (held-out R2=0.87, size-independent) and directional on real data (R2 ~= 0.55). We are explicit about what does not hold: a near-boundary-vertex predictor is the wrong model (we pre-registered one and rejected it), a selectivity regime forecaster did not materialize, and the worst case is the trivial Omega(v) read bound on adversarially interleaved boundaries. We contribute the mechanism, budget-honest decode accounting, and an open harness; we do not claim a new index.
